Sentence (English): With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?"
Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother washes the dishes after every meal, so she only uses two or three dishes a day. ] || ---------------- || With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

'물을 너무 많이 쓰진 않을까?', '전기요금이 부담되지는 않을까?', '설거지를 제대로 하지 못하면 어쩌지?' 같은 의문들이 머릿속을 맴돌았습니다. 특히 부모님 두 분이 사용하시는데 14인용 식기세척기는 너무 큰 건 아닐까 싶었지만, 여러 상품평에서 식기세척기는 클 수록 좋다는 얘기를 보고 마음을 굳혔습니다. 결국 2인 가족이지만 14인용 제품을 선택하게 되었어요.설치 당일, 기사님이 오셔서 아주 꼼꼼하고 친절하게 설명해 주셨어요. 주방 공간에 맞춰 설치도 잘 해주시고, 사용법부터 관리 요령까지 차근차근 알려주셔서 처음 쓰는 저희도 전혀 어렵지 않았습니다. 무엇보다 감동적이었던 건, 첫 사용 후 반짝이는 그릇을 보고 어머니가 미소 지으신 순간이었어요. “너무 깨끗하다”하시며 만족스러워하셨고, 이후엔 설거지를 맡기고 운동을 다니십니다. 하루에 30분도 내기 힘들던 어머니의 운동시간이 식기세척기 덕분에 생긴 거죠. 그 모습에 아버지도 “이거 참 잘 샀다” 하시며 함께 기뻐하셨습니다.제품을 사용하면서 걱정했던 부분들도 대부분 기우였다는 걸 알게 됐어요. 물 사용량은 손설거지보다 훨씬 적었고, 전기요금도 생각보다 많이 오르지 않았습니다. 세제사용도 간편하고, 무엇보다 손목과 팔이 아프신 어머니께 큰 도움이 된다는 점이 가장 감사했어요.“왜 이제 샀을까?” 이 말은 어머니뿐 아니라 저희 가족 모두가 한 말입니다. 편리함은 물론이고, 어머니가 자신만의 시간을 찾고 건강을 회복해 가시는 모습을 보면서 이 제품은 단순한 가전이 아니라 가족의 삶의 질을 높여주는 ‘작은 혁신’이란 생각이 들었습니다.식기세척기 구매를 망설이고 계신 분들께 진심으로 말씀드리고 싶어요. 혹시나 하는 걱정은 해보지 않으면 모릅니다. 저희도 그런 고민 끝에 결국 구매했고, 지금은 하루하루 만족하며 사용하고 있습니다. 가족의 건강, 시간, 삶의 여유를 생각하신다면 꼭 한 번 고려해보시길 바랍니다. 저희처럼 더 빨리 사지 않은 걸 아쉬워하실지도 몰라요.

Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother washes the dishes after every meal, so she only uses two or three dishes a day. ] || ---------------- || With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

Sentence (English): My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase.
Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother washes the dishes after every meal, so she only uses two or three dishes a day. ] || ---------------- || With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

Sentence (English): Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family.
Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother washes the dishes after every meal, so she only uses two or three dishes a day. ] || ---------------- || With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

Comments (English): [ These days, with prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've often wondered, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother washes the dishes after every meal, so she only uses two or three dishes a day. ] || ---------------- || With prices rising and electricity bills rising, I've been wondering countless times, "Should I really buy a dishwasher?" My mother used to stand in front of the sink two or three times a day to wash dishes after every meal, and a few months ago, she started to feel pain in her arms. At first, I thought it was just fatigue, but she kept saying that it hurt more and more. So my family started seriously considering buying a dishwasher. However, when it came time to make the decision to buy one, we had a lot of worries. Questions like "Will it use too much water?", "Will the electricity bill be a burden?", and "What if I can't wash the dishes properly?" were in our heads. In particular, I thought that a 14-person dishwasher might be too big for my parents, but I made up my mind after reading several product reviews that said that the bigger the dishwasher, the better. In the end, we ended up choosing a 14-person product for our family of two. On the day of installation, the technician came and explained it very thoroughly and kindly. They installed it well to fit the kitchen space, and explained everything from how to use it to how to maintain it step by step, so it was not difficult at all for us who were using it for the first time. The most touching thing was when my mother smiled after using it for the first time and saw the shiny dishes. She was satisfied, saying that it was so clean, and after that, she left the dishes to do the washing and went to work out. My mother, who had difficulty finding even 30 minutes a day to exercise, was able to do it thanks to the dishwasher. My father was also happy to see that I made a good purchase. I realized that most of my worries while using the product were unfounded. The water usage was much less than washing dishes by hand, and the electricity bill did not increase as much as I thought. The detergent was easy to use, and most of all, I was thankful that it was a great help to my mother who had sore wrists and arms. Why did I buy it now? This is what my whole family said. Not only is it convenient, but seeing my mother find time for herself and recover her health made me think that this product is not just a simple home appliance, but a 'small innovation' that improves the quality of life for the family. I sincerely want to tell those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher. You don't know if you're worried until you try it. We also worried about that and eventually bought it, and now we use it every day with satisfaction. If you think about your family's health, time, and leisure, please consider it. You may regret not buying it sooner like we did.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is our second Whirlpool, and is replacing an almost identical model.
Comments (English): [ Love the third rack. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is our second Whirlpool, and is replacing an almost identical model. Installation was a breeze, and the third rack is fantastic. The tines are simple and it's easy to load. We use the extended dry feature, but the regular dry gets most things fully dry. Mugs with large bottom intentations or rimmed plastic containers might have some leftover water on regular dry. It's fairly quiet but not as quiet as our last model, which had more insulation around the bottom trim/mechanicals. Our kitchen is separate from our living area, so it's not a big deal. It's only a few decibels louder. If you have a great room with kitchen and living combined, you might want one a little quieter if you run your dishwasher a lot. My only other caution is if you previously had a dishwasher with a front trim kit that covers the gap between the dishwasher and the floor, this model arrives with a plate that doesn't fully trim out the front. It secures the insulation and covers the mechanicals. You'll need your own trim piece to fully finish it out or keep the one from your old dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Very good device, for today ] || ---------------- || The washing machine is extraordinary from many points of view. Beyond the fact that it washes well, the connectivity and the ability to start it remotely if the door is closed and the capsule is inserted are very welcome. Now they can't all be positive. And the possibility of modifying how thick the support "teeth" are has somewhat disappeared and in general the configurability of the interior is no longer at the same level. Sentence (English): I do not recommend this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Lemon or Bad Design? ] || ---------------- || I do not recommend this dishwasher! I had the dishwasher for less than two months when it suddenly stopped working mid-cycle. Bosch technicians are only available during week days from 8-5. So scheduling an appointment was inconvenient. The technician assumed Best Buy hadn't installed the dishwasher properly and was expecting an easy fix. If that had been the issue, she would have "had to" charge me, because Bosch technicians "do not do installations." But in fact, there was a mechanical problem; something wrong with the machine itself. The technician didn't have all of the parts needed to fix the issue, which meant having to schedule another appointment. And even though she was going to be at a training the following week, Bosch refused to assign another technician or give me the approval code to have one of their "partner technicians" fix the dishwasher. So I had to wait another two weeks before the Bosch technician could return. After switching out the three electronic components of the dishwasher for absolutely new parts, the dishwasher still would not turn on. The technician explained that Bosch has recently added a third electronic component to their latest dishwasher, and this is the part that is malfunctioning. She said the issue I am having with my dishwasher is NOT the first time she has seen this. Now I am waiting to hear back from Bosch about replacing my dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Very quiet as advertised, almost to the point of being silent at times.
Comments (English): [ Nice machine but ] || ---------------- || Very quiet as advertised, almost to the point of being silent at times. Also does a good job of cleaning; spotless dishes and the top rack does great for the silverware. But for a DIY installation it's challenging at best. I reviewed the manual before purchasing, but found the vertical measurement is an absolute bare minimum as I had to remove all 4 feet and cut the top of the insulation blanket to make it fit when my countertop is 1/4" higher than the stated minimum. There is NO ROOM to work underneath. Tried to use the existing copper line from my old Whirlpool and Maytag machines; had it all lined up to the inlet, but it was not possible to turn a wrench enough to tighten the compression fitting so had to resort to the flexible line that needs to be replaced every 5 years. Same with electrical; very difficult to work with the terminal block rather than simple wire nuts with past machines. Also no space at at all under the motor to push the excess romex out of the way so I had to fold it up somehow but then it got in the way of the front insulation and kick panel. Very frustrating process. Finally, the racking takes a bit of imagination to load. Not very versatile as far as accommodating various pieces tableware.

Sentence (English): I am not a fan of this dishwasher's interior configuration.
Comments (English): [ Probably wouldn't buy again. ] || ---------------- || I am not a fan of this dishwasher's interior configuration. The silverware compartments are all on the side, so one has to fully open the dishwasher and roll the bottom level out to add a spoon. There seems no place to put a bowl or a pan, only plates. Glassware is also challenging, as the base of the upper carriage is all slanted various ways so that 12-16 oz. glasses are unbalanced. I have no idea what sort of dishes this was designed for, but again, not any sort of bowls. The bottle jets are nice, but I rarely need them. I wanted the handle on the front, and that was a major reason I bought it, but because you have to open and roll the carriages out whenever adding any little item, the towel on the handle just goes on the floor. I do like the shallow uppermost drawer for jar lids and scissors.This dishwasher beeps all the time, sometimes when I have not even touched an y part of it. It cleans well and is quiet enough, another consideration for me. (aside from all the beeping).I just wish I had brought some dishes to the store to try the interior loading out.

Installer said that per Envision policy, customer cleaning or replacement wasn't allowed and we could either cancel the installation or pay the $150. Spacious 12-person size I thought 12 people were too big, but even if I only eat three meals a day, there is a lot of dishwashing. Even if you put in cups, plates, and pots, there is plenty of space, so you can wash them all at once, so the size is also large. Especially on days when you have guests or cook a lot, it fits everything comfortably, so it's great! 9 washing cycles These days, I change the cycles depending on the amount of dishes I wash or the level of contamination each day. In particular, thanks to the automatic door opening function, the moisture inside completely disappears after washing, so the dishes dry fluffy. The internal design is very smart. No more worries about the layout! At first, I was confused as to how to put the dishes efficiently, but the internal structure is so reasonable that if you put the bowl, bowl, pot, and spoon in the exact place, it all goes in 'without a single error', and it feels like playing Tetris. Sentence (English): Everyone says that robot vacuum cleaners and dishwashers change the quality of life, so why did I buy them now?
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has really changed, I love it! ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Everyone says that robot vacuum cleaners and dishwashers change the quality of life, so why did I buy them now? They are so good that I forgot the word 'dishwashing stress' with just one dishwasher. Spacious 12-person size I thought 12 people were too big, but even if I only eat three meals a day, there is a lot of dishwashing. Even if you put in cups, plates, and pots, there is plenty of space, so you can wash them all at once, so the size is also large. Especially on days when you have guests or cook a lot, it fits everything comfortably, so it's great! 9 washing cycles These days, I change the cycles depending on the amount of dishes I wash or the level of contamination each day. After cooking greasy dishes, I use the high-temperature, strong washing cycle, and for dishes after eating a light meal in the morning, I use the eco mode! In particular, thanks to the automatic door opening function, the moisture inside completely disappears after washing, so the dishes dry fluffy. The internal design is very smart. No more worries about the layout! At first, I was confused as to how to put the dishes efficiently, but the internal structure is so reasonable that if you put the bowl, bowl, pot, and spoon in the exact place, it all goes in 'without a single error', and it feels like playing Tetris. The upper and lower two-stage spray blades are strong, so they cleanly wash every corner of the plate. Even old chili oil is cleared without a problem! Coupang A/S is free for 2 years! I trust and use it. One of the things I like the most! Usually, when you buy home appliances, you have to contact the manufacturer separately for A/S, which is inconvenient, but since this is Coupang's direct business, Coupang handles A/S, and the fact that it is guaranteed free for 2 years is a really big advantage! You can apply right away on the Coupang app when you need it, and they also have a call center 24/7. The installer is very professional and kind. At first, I thought that I should cut the marble of the sink because I was worried that the dishwasher wouldn't fit, but the kind installer took off the lid, measured it here and there with a ruler, and said it would work. He installed it so well that it fit perfectly like a built-in! Thanks to the technician, I think the installation was done neatly and I am completely satisfied! Overall Review - Pros: Generous capacity, various washing courses, powerful washing power, automatic drying function, reliable A/S - Cons: You need to secure the installation space in advance! Sentence (English): Good dishwasher but can be made much better especially for the price point.
Comments (English): Good dishwasher but can be made much better especially for the price point. It has a large capacity and washes well. The drying is not the best I've experienced. As soon as a cycle is finished and door is opened I notice less steam and more water on the loading baskets than I recall with other brands in the past.Some of the features described are missing, such as extra dry, auto door open and inside light. If they want to release models without these features then do so, instead of listing something that cannot be obtained. Also write a manual for each model. Right now its full of 'based on model', when this is the most advanced model you can buy. You have to spend half a day to decipher the manual and inspect the product to see what works, what doesn't work and how it works.The App is good, because it does let you remote control unlike some other brands which just show status. However there are some short comings which can be easily fixed by software/firmware upgrade.Firstly, In order to use the app you have to press the remote control button on the machine, after a long press turn on. However it looses the ability to remote control if you open and close the door. If they kept to stay on unless pressed off it would be a better user experience as it should stay in the state the user wants, like a light switch.Secondly the delay end feature does not work at all, it starts the cycle regardless of end time. You also cannot choose next day times. Further more there should be a delay start time option as its easier to know when you want to the start rather than calculate the end of a cycle.

Sentence (English): Very quiet as advertised, almost to the point of being silent at times.
Comments (English): [ Nice machine but ] || ---------------- || Very quiet as advertised, almost to the point of being silent at times. Also does a good job of cleaning; spotless dishes and the top rack does great for the silverware. But for a DIY installation it's challenging at best. I reviewed the manual before purchasing, but found the vertical measurement is an absolute bare minimum as I had to remove all 4 feet and cut the top of the insulation blanket to make it fit when my countertop is 1/4\" higher than the stated minimum. There is NO ROOM to work underneath. Tried to use the existing copper line from my old Whirlpool and Maytag machines; had it all lined up to the inlet, but it was not possible to turn a wrench enough to tighten the compression fitting so had to resort to the flexible line that needs to be replaced every 5 years. Same with electrical; very difficult to work with the terminal block rather than simple wire nuts with past machines. Also no space at at all under the motor to push the excess romex out of the way so I had to fold it up somehow but then it got in the way of the front insulation and kick panel. Very frustrating process. Finally, the racking takes a bit of imagination to load. Not very versatile as far as accommodating various pieces tableware.

Sentence (English): I don't find the dishwasher all that quiet.
Comments (English): [ Needs a few design adjustment. ] || ---------------- || I don't find the dishwasher all that quiet. It is quiet as far as the motor and pumping noises but there is a fair amount of swishing noises as water, I assume, is hitting the door. The thing I most dislike is the bottom rack arrangement. There is really a small amount of room if you are using larger bowls and the like. Lots of room for plates but I wish the tines were adjustable down below. Manual shows bowls on their side and neatly arranges but the written instructions say the bowls etc must be placed with the opening facing down. When you do that, not much room for very many bowls. Also the cutlery holder takes up a lot of room but the top rack does a really good job cleaning the cutlery. The dishwasher itself does an excellent job cleaning the dishes and kitchenware. I love the stainless steel look alike door. Most of my appliances are stainless steel and none of them look as clean as the fake stainless, except right after polishing it. No spots, no fingerprints, easy wipe down occasionally.

Sentence (English): So far so good.
Comments (English): [ So so quiet ] || ---------------- || So far so good. I've only had this dishwasher for a couple of months and are empty nesters; therefore, don't use it as often as a family with children. I am impressed with how quiet it is. The only way I can tell it's running is by the digital time display on the door or by putting my ear against the washer door. I also like the one-hour wash cycle option. In deciding whether to purchase this unit or not, I read many reviews saying there was a leaking problem. This hasn't happened to us and wonder if it's more due to installation errors rather than the unit itself. I watched our installer, provided by Costco, secure multiple small plastic plugs on the inside rim of the washer, by the door. Perhaps this is what's causing the water leak? I can imagine an inexperience installer forgetting this step. It's just a guess on my part.

Cannot choose auto air if it wasnt already lit up before selecting 60 speed. 6) 60 minutes speed takes hours. 7) The layout of the prongs on bottom rack are pretty horrible for anything odd shapped. Sentence (English): My father recently commented that I have been treating this dishwasher like a baby since its recent installation, which infuriated me because this supposedly "premium" dishwasher with a $900 price tag has given me nothing but a total nightmare.
Comments (English): [ Piece of garbage worth only $100 ] || ---------------- || My father recently commented that I have been treating this dishwasher like a baby since its recent installation, which infuriated me because this supposedly "premium" dishwasher with a $900 price tag has given me nothing but a total nightmare. First of all, its drying feature is a complete joke. The three drying feature, "Sanitize", "Extra Dry" and "Intensive Drying", even when used in combination, does nothing to make a difference, and your plates, rack and the appliance interior would still come out of the wash cycle like you would come out of a shower without a towel. For some reasons, the Bosch designers think that having a heating rod placed in the unit or "moisture vent fan" are such bad ideas because "it consumes more energy", so a "greener" idea is to just let the moisture build up inside. Sure, you can expect a lot of "green" mold growing "naturally" in your dishwasher. The solution? According to BestBuy's customer rep, you have to "manually use a towel to wipe dry the interior after each washing cycle". Another "lower-maintenance" solution is to upgrade for a "higher-end" and pricier models like the 500/800 or Benchmark series that do feature the heating rod and vent fans. But wait, I thought they are such terrible ideas so why featuring them in the even more “premium” models? Maybe that's the real reason to call such a piece of crap “green” - all because of $$$. But putting this blatant hypocrisy aside, rest assured that even if you treat this model like a baby and spend 20 minutes everyday babysitting it, the mold and odor will not go away - they will just hide somewhere else out of your sight, because this model also does not have any feature to allow you to just perform the draining action, and the condensed water on the interior wall will, after the cycle ends, eventually flow and collect into the drain and accumulate there, enabling mold and odor to germinate there. Therefore, it's impossible for them to be pumped out after the cycle ends, contrary to Bosch's claim. In the User's Manual, Bosch incredibly and unabashedly states the following in the Troubleshooting section: “Appliance interior still wet after wash cycle: Not an error. Condensation drying creates water droplets in the tub. This is normal. Moisture in the air condenses on the inside walls of the appliance, runs off, and is pumped out. No action required.” My only disagreement would be that there is one action needed here indeed: a class-action lawsuit against this fraudulent company masquerading low-end dishwashers without basic functionality to perform proper drying and drainage, most of which are widely available on even low end models made by other brands, and causing biological and environmental hazards to the health of millions of American households. Unless they are taught a proper lesson, nothing will stop their greed from continuing to commit such atrocities.

The functions are well described in the product description, so I will review mainly what I liked and what I regretted after actually using it. The review is a bit long because the product is so good! The summary and regrets are at the bottom! The photos are comparison photos before and after using the dishwasher, and the video is a noise test! Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. The functions are well described in the product description, so I will review mainly what I liked and what I regretted after actually using it. The review is a bit long because the product is so good! The summary and regrets are at the bottom! The photos are comparison photos before and after using the dishwasher, and the video is a noise test! Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. The review is a bit long because the product is so good! The summary and regrets are at the bottom! The photos are comparison photos before and after using the dishwasher, and the video is a noise test! Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. The review is a bit long because the product is so good! The summary and regrets are at the bottom! Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. The review is a bit long because the product is so good! The summary and regrets are at the bottom! The photos are comparison photos before and after using the dishwasher, and the video is a noise test! Number of family members: 2 people + 1 dog Detergent used: Frosh [Cleaning power] Attached photo The reason I did not use a dishwasher until now is that I thought, 'Wouldn't human hands be better than a dishwasher?' I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

[For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Hello? I have lived for 3n years without a dishwasher. I am writing this review at a good opportunity. I think I didn't buy it because I thought that. In fact, I didn't believe it right before I used it, so I thought, 'I'll see how well it washes.' I put the bowl I used to eat ramen in the first layer, and the spatula with the rice stuck to it in the third layer. There is an automatic door-opening function after the dishwasher cycle is over, and when the door opens, steam comes out. It seems to be washed by being blown by high-temperature steam. People say that no matter how high the temperature is, it doesn't go over 50 degrees even if they wear rubber gloves, but this dishwasher washes by being blown by high-temperature steam of 70-90 degrees (depending on the mode). As you can see in the picture, it was washed very well. 'Dishwashers are better than human hands! ' Now I admit it and use it very well. [For 12 people] If you are considering this product, you might be debating whether to buy a domestic brand product for 6 people or this 12-person product. The saying goes that when it comes to home appliances, the bigger the better, and I think that applies to dishwashers as well. Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. If you bought a dishwasher and washed the dishes by hand, it would be a loss~_~ If there are more than 3 people in your family and you have enough kitchen space, I would definitely recommend buying a 12-person one. [Cost-effectiveness] The Midea brand may be a little unfamiliar in Korea, but it is said to be a very famous company overseas. The installer came and installed it while saying, "This company is a good company~~". To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good. [Installation and design] The installer came over the weekend and installed it with Rocket Installation. This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. Even though it is a foreign product, Coupang provided a free 2-year warranty, which was good, and it was also good that I could get it repaired for a fee even after 2 years. [Disappointing points] 1. Although there are wash + dry and rinse + dry courses, there is no separate function to just dry when I want to do it separately. 2. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. It is a great dishwasher with a neat design and cost-effectiveness, including a 3-tier shelf (knife and scissors holder), 12-person capacity, steam + air, cutlery holder, automatic door opening, app linkage, etc., and flagship functions. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Since the dishwasher is large, I liked that there was plenty of space to put pots, frying pans, and slightly larger dishes. To be honest, if you buy a product with all the functions of a domestic brand, it would cost twice as much, but the cost-effectiveness is very good.
