This product is a freestanding product, but I wanted to put it in the sink space like a built-in one, so the installer neatly removed the existing sink + mop holder and put the dishwasher in its place. The overall clean white tone and the touch panel are also neatly black, so I liked that it didn't spoil the kitchen's appearance in terms of design. [App linkage] After downloading the 'SmartHome' app, you can link it after connecting to 2G wifi! [A/S] It seems to be a product that Coupang imports and sells directly. The bottom of the cutlery holder has large holes, so chopsticks sometimes fall out. 3. The energy efficiency rating is level 3. [Summary] For me, who did not have a dishwasher, it was so convenient that I regretted not experiencing the dishwasher sooner. I hope my review was helpful in purchasing the product :)

Comments (English): [ #Kitchen essentials #Low noise #Pretty design #Frying pan OK ] || ---------------- || This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. My wrists have been getting numb a lot lately. The hospital told me not to overdo it, but I can’t avoid doing the dishes. I sigh when I see the dishes pile up every meal. After my child and husband eat, I feel like the whole day is wasted doing the dishes alone. These days, the food is greasy, the detergent doesn’t foam well, I waste water and time, and my whole body feels sore. So I decided to make up my mind to buy a dishwasher. At first, the price was a bit burdensome, so I put it in and took it out of my shopping cart several times. However, this Mydia product is the best in terms of cost-effectiveness compared to other products, and its simple design really caught my eye. Above all, it’s large enough for 12 people, so I can use it comfortably, and I can put all the dishes in and wash them at once after the family eats, which was great. Since the installation includes on-site installation, I chose it right away without thinking too much. If I’m going to do it anyway, I feel much more at ease if the technician comes in person. Let me start with the advantages. First, I am very satisfied with the cleaning power. At first, I wondered how well a machine could wash dishes. But this is actually quite thorough. It cleans oily frying pans and rice bowls with dried rice! At first, I intentionally put it in without pre-washing it as a test. It really did remove the oil stains cleanly. At that time, I thought this was really good. I bought a separate detergent specifically for dishwashers, and it seems to go well with it. I like it because there are no detergent marks on the dishes and there is almost no smell. The design is clean and neat without any unnecessary elements, so it doesn't look awkward even if you leave it in the kitchen. Maybe because it's white, it feels more spacious. It's also quieter than I thought. It makes a little noise when it first starts, but once it starts running, it's almost unnoticeable. I like that I can run it at night when the kids are sleeping. Since it can hold 12 people, it's perfect if you put it in after finishing a meal. Since you collect the dishes and do it all at once, you save water and time. There is ample space for dishes, so you can fit most pots and frying pans. It is divided into compartments, so you can put plates and cups in it safely. At first, I wondered how to arrange it, but after a few tries, I got the hang of it. The buttons are intuitive and emoticon-type, so they are easy to use. The installation technician explained the operation step by step when I installed it, so I could understand it right away without looking at the manual. I saw some reviews saying that the washing time felt long when using a dishwasher, but since we put it on before going to bed at night, it didn’t feel particularly long. And this product is really smart because the door opens slightly after washing and dries cleanly. At first, I remember watching the dishwasher door open because it was so amazing. Now, I’m so used to it that I can’t even imagine life without a dishwasher. I don’t even think about the piled up dishes that give me a headache once or twice a day. I just put them in after eating and press the button. My husband and I don’t fight over the dishes, and my kids help me put the dishes in, so that’s also a life lesson. This alone has made the atmosphere in my house a little more harmonious. It’s not an exaggeration. I like the design, and it makes the kitchen look much more organized. It’s not hard to use after just a few days. It’s my favorite kitchen appliance these days. It’s especially great for people with bad wrists, people who are busy taking care of children, and dual-income households. Even first-time users like me don’t have to worry too much. The installer took care of everything, and it’s not hard to use, so I got the hang of it quickly. It’s no exaggeration to say that this one product has completely changed my kitchen life. Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

 처음엔 테스트 삼아 일부러 애벌세척하지 않고 넣어봤는데요. 진짜로 기름때까지 말끔하게 빠지더라고요. 그때 이거 진짜 괜찮다 싶었어요.  세제는 식기세척기 전용으로 따로 샀는데 그거랑 궁합도 잘 맞는 것 같고요. 식기마다 세제 자국도 안 남고 냄새도 거의 없어서 마음에 들어요. 디자인은 군더더기 없이 깔끔해서 주방에 놔둬도 어색하지 않아요. 흰색이라 그런지 더 넓어보이는 느낌도 있어요.  소음도 생각보다 조용해요. 처음 작동할 땐 소리가 살짝 나는데 돌다 보면 거의 신경 안 쓰일 정도예요. 밤에 아이들 자고 있을 때도 돌릴 수 있어서 좋아요.  용량이 12인용이라 한 끼 식사 끝내고 싹 넣으면 딱이에요. 설거지감 모아서 한 번에 처리하니까 물도 절약되고 시간도 절약돼요.  그릇 넣는 공간도 넉넉해서 냄비나 프라이팬도 웬만한 건 다 들어가요. 칸칸이 나눠져 있어서 접시나 컵도 안정적으로 넣을 수 있고요. 처음엔 이거 어떻게 배열해야 하나 싶었는데 몇번 해보니까 딱 감이 오더라구요.  버튼도 터치식에 이모티콘 형식으로 직관적이라 사용하기 편하더라구요. 작동법은 설치할때 설치 기사님이 따로 차근차근 설명해주셔서 설명서 안보더라도 바로 이해할 수 있었어요.  식세기 사용하면 세척 시간도 길게 느껴진다는 후기들 봤었는데 저희 집은 저녁에 자기전에 돌려놓고 자기 때문에 딱히 길다고 느껴지진 않았어요. 그리고 이 제품은 세척이 끝나면 자동으로 문이 살짝 열려서 건조까지 깔끔하게 되는 게 참 똑똑하더라구요. 처음에는 식기세척기 문이 열리는 게 신기해서 계속 지켜봤던 기억이 나네요. 지금은 너무 익숙해서 식기세척기 없는 삶은 상상도 못 하겠어요.  하루에 한두 번씩 머리 아프게 쌓인 설거지 생각하는 것도 이젠 없어요. 그냥 식사 끝나면 싹 넣고 버튼만 누르면 끝이에요.  설거지 때문에 부부싸움도 안 하게 되고 아이들도 그릇 가져다 넣는 건 도와줘서 그것도 생활 교육이 되네요. 이거 하나로 집안 분위기가 좀 더 화목해졌달까 진짜 과장이 아니에요.  디자인도 맘에 들고 주방이 훨씬 정돈돼 보이는 효과도 있고 사용법도 며칠만 써보면 어렵지 않아요. 요즘은 제가 제일 애정하는 주방 가전이에요.  특히 손목이 안 좋은 분들 아이들 챙기느라 바쁜 분들 맞벌이 가정에도 너무 잘 맞는 제품 같아요.  저처럼 처음 쓰는 분들도 너무 걱정 안 하셔도 될 것 같아요. 설치도 기사님이 다 알아서 해주시고 사용법도 어렵지 않아서 금방 익혀요.  이 제품 하나로 제 주방 생활이 완전히 달라졌다고 해도 과언이 아니에요. 이제는 식기세척기 없이 지냈던 시절이 잘 기억도 안 나요.  정말 추천드리고 싶은 제품이에요❤️ 이제 제 주방에서 없어서는 안 될 존재가 됐어요!

Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

My wrists have been getting numb a lot lately. The hospital told me not to overdo it, but I can’t avoid doing the dishes. I sigh when I see the dishes pile up every meal. After my child and husband eat, I feel like the whole day is wasted doing the dishes alone. These days, the food is greasy, the detergent doesn’t foam well, I waste water and time, and my whole body feels sore. So I decided to make up my mind to buy a dishwasher. At first, the price was a bit burdensome, so I put it in and took it out of my shopping cart several times. However, this Mydia product is the best in terms of cost-effectiveness compared to other products, and its simple design really caught my eye. Above all, it’s large enough for 12 people, so I can use it comfortably, and I can put all the dishes in and wash them at once after the family eats, which was great. Since the installation includes on-site installation, I chose it right away without thinking too much. If I’m going to do it anyway, I feel much more at ease if the technician comes in person. Let me start with the advantages. First, I am very satisfied with the cleaning power. At first, I wondered how well a machine could wash dishes. But this is actually quite thorough. It cleans oily frying pans and rice bowls with dried rice! At first, I intentionally put it in without pre-washing it as a test. It really did remove the oil stains cleanly. At that time, I thought this was really good. I bought a separate detergent specifically for dishwashers, and it seems to go well with it. I like it because there are no detergent marks on the dishes and there is almost no smell. The design is clean and neat without any unnecessary elements, so it doesn't look awkward even if you leave it in the kitchen. Maybe because it's white, it feels more spacious. It's also quieter than I thought. It makes a little noise when it first starts, but once it starts running, it's almost unnoticeable. I like that I can run it at night when the kids are sleeping. Since it can hold 12 people, it's perfect if you put it in after finishing a meal. Since you collect the dishes and do it all at once, you save water and time. There is ample space for dishes, so you can fit most pots and frying pans. It is divided into compartments, so you can put plates and cups in it safely. At first, I wondered how to arrange it, but after a few tries, I got the hang of it. The buttons are intuitive and emoticon-type, so they are easy to use. The installation technician explained the operation step by step when I installed it, so I could understand it right away without looking at the manual. I saw some reviews saying that the washing time felt long when using a dishwasher, but since we put it on before going to bed at night, it didn’t feel particularly long. And this product is really smart because the door opens slightly after washing and dries cleanly. At first, I remember watching the dishwasher door open because it was so amazing. Now, I’m so used to it that I can’t even imagine life without a dishwasher. I don’t even think about the piled up dishes that give me a headache once or twice a day. I just put them in after eating and press the button. My husband and I don’t fight over the dishes, and my kids help me put the dishes in, so that’s also a life lesson. This alone has made the atmosphere in my house a little more harmonious. It’s not an exaggeration. I like the design, and it makes the kitchen look much more organized. It’s not hard to use after just a few days. It’s my favorite kitchen appliance these days. It’s especially great for people with bad wrists, people who are busy taking care of children, and dual-income households. Even first-time users like me don’t have to worry too much. The installer took care of everything, and it’s not hard to use, so I got the hang of it quickly. It’s no exaggeration to say that this one product has completely changed my kitchen life. Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

My wrists have been getting numb a lot lately. The hospital told me not to overdo it, but I can’t avoid doing the dishes. I sigh when I see the dishes pile up every meal. After my child and husband eat, I feel like the whole day is wasted doing the dishes alone. These days, the food is greasy, the detergent doesn’t foam well, I waste water and time, and my whole body feels sore. So I decided to make up my mind to buy a dishwasher. At first, the price was a bit burdensome, so I put it in and took it out of my shopping cart several times. However, this Mydia product is the best in terms of cost-effectiveness compared to other products, and its simple design really caught my eye. Above all, it’s large enough for 12 people, so I can use it comfortably, and I can put all the dishes in and wash them at once after the family eats, which was great. Since the installation includes on-site installation, I chose it right away without thinking too much. If I’m going to do it anyway, I feel much more at ease if the technician comes in person. Let me start with the advantages. First, I am very satisfied with the cleaning power. At first, I wondered how well a machine could wash dishes. But this is actually quite thorough. It cleans oily frying pans and rice bowls with dried rice! At first, I intentionally put it in without pre-washing it as a test. It really did remove the oil stains cleanly. At that time, I thought this was really good. I bought a separate detergent specifically for dishwashers, and it seems to go well with it. I like it because there are no detergent marks on the dishes and there is almost no smell. The design is clean and neat without any unnecessary elements, so it doesn't look awkward even if you leave it in the kitchen. Maybe because it's white, it feels more spacious. It's also quieter than I thought. It makes a little noise when it first starts, but once it starts running, it's almost unnoticeable. I like that I can run it at night when the kids are sleeping. Since it can hold 12 people, it's perfect if you put it in after finishing a meal. Since you collect the dishes and do it all at once, you save water and time. There is ample space for dishes, so you can fit most pots and frying pans. It is divided into compartments, so you can put plates and cups in it safely. At first, I wondered how to arrange it, but after a few tries, I got the hang of it. The buttons are intuitive and emoticon-type, so they are easy to use. The installation technician explained the operation step by step when I installed it, so I could understand it right away without looking at the manual. I saw some reviews saying that the washing time felt long when using a dishwasher, but since we put it on before going to bed at night, it didn’t feel particularly long. And this product is really smart because the door opens slightly after washing and dries cleanly. At first, I remember watching the dishwasher door open because it was so amazing. Now, I’m so used to it that I can’t even imagine life without a dishwasher. I don’t even think about the piled up dishes that give me a headache once or twice a day. I just put them in after eating and press the button. My husband and I don’t fight over the dishes, and my kids help me put the dishes in, so that’s also a life lesson. This alone has made the atmosphere in my house a little more harmonious. It’s not an exaggeration. I like the design, and it makes the kitchen look much more organized. It’s not hard to use after just a few days. It’s my favorite kitchen appliance these days. It’s especially great for people with bad wrists, people who are busy taking care of children, and dual-income households. Even first-time users like me don’t have to worry too much. The installer took care of everything, and it’s not hard to use, so I got the hang of it quickly. It’s no exaggeration to say that this one product has completely changed my kitchen life. Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

My wrists have been getting numb a lot lately. The hospital told me not to overdo it, but I can’t avoid doing the dishes. I sigh when I see the dishes pile up every meal. After my child and husband eat, I feel like the whole day is wasted doing the dishes alone. These days, the food is greasy, the detergent doesn’t foam well, I waste water and time, and my whole body feels sore. So I decided to make up my mind to buy a dishwasher. At first, the price was a bit burdensome, so I put it in and took it out of my shopping cart several times. However, this Mydia product is the best in terms of cost-effectiveness compared to other products, and its simple design really caught my eye. Above all, it’s large enough for 12 people, so I can use it comfortably, and I can put all the dishes in and wash them at once after the family eats, which was great. Since the installation includes on-site installation, I chose it right away without thinking too much. If I’m going to do it anyway, I feel much more at ease if the technician comes in person. Let me start with the advantages. First, I am very satisfied with the cleaning power. At first, I wondered how well a machine could wash dishes. But this is actually quite thorough. It cleans oily frying pans and rice bowls with dried rice! At first, I intentionally put it in without pre-washing it as a test. It really did remove the oil stains cleanly. At that time, I thought this was really good. I bought a separate detergent specifically for dishwashers, and it seems to go well with it. I like it because there are no detergent marks on the dishes and there is almost no smell. The design is clean and neat without any unnecessary elements, so it doesn't look awkward even if you leave it in the kitchen. Maybe because it's white, it feels more spacious. It's also quieter than I thought. It makes a little noise when it first starts, but once it starts running, it's almost unnoticeable. I like that I can run it at night when the kids are sleeping. Since it can hold 12 people, it's perfect if you put it in after finishing a meal. Since you collect the dishes and do it all at once, you save water and time. There is ample space for dishes, so you can fit most pots and frying pans. It is divided into compartments, so you can put plates and cups in it safely. At first, I wondered how to arrange it, but after a few tries, I got the hang of it. The buttons are intuitive and emoticon-type, so they are easy to use. The installation technician explained the operation step by step when I installed it, so I could understand it right away without looking at the manual. I saw some reviews saying that the washing time felt long when using a dishwasher, but since we put it on before going to bed at night, it didn’t feel particularly long. And this product is really smart because the door opens slightly after washing and dries cleanly. At first, I remember watching the dishwasher door open because it was so amazing. Now, I’m so used to it that I can’t even imagine life without a dishwasher. I don’t even think about the piled up dishes that give me a headache once or twice a day. I just put them in after eating and press the button. My husband and I don’t fight over the dishes, and my kids help me put the dishes in, so that’s also a life lesson. This alone has made the atmosphere in my house a little more harmonious. It’s not an exaggeration. I like the design, and it makes the kitchen look much more organized. It’s not hard to use after just a few days. It’s my favorite kitchen appliance these days. It’s especially great for people with bad wrists, people who are busy taking care of children, and dual-income households. Even first-time users like me don’t have to worry too much. The installer took care of everything, and it’s not hard to use, so I got the hang of it quickly. It’s no exaggeration to say that this one product has completely changed my kitchen life. Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

Now I can’t even remember a time when I didn’t have a dishwasher. I really want to recommend this product. It’s now become an indispensable part of my kitchen!

Sentence (English): I urgently purchased and installed this before starting the interior film work, and I am very satisfied.
Comments (English): [ It works perfectly! ] || ---------------- || I urgently purchased and installed this before starting the interior film work, and I am very satisfied. Usually, installing a dishwasher involves cabinet remodeling, so I was advised to install it before the film application; I ordered it in a hurry, and it was installed immediately. It really is Rocket Installation! The LG technician contacted me to ask about remodeling, and if I said no, they connected me with a technician who could do the remodeling. In my case, the remodeling fee was between 100,000 and 200,000 won. Since the technician who came for the installation was also the one who does the remodeling, only one person came, and the installation, including the remodeling, took about two hours. They brought a table saw, cut the cabinets in the hallway, installed the new ones, and cleaned up the area before leaving. There is some noise when cutting, so you should be aware of that. After installation, they gave me a simple guide on how to use it and connected it to the app before leaving. It is my first dishwasher, and I am extremely satisfied. First of all, the design is beige, so it matches the interior film (Valentine Moody) I chose perfectly. I hate having food scraps floating around in the disposer, so I soak the dishes as much as possible (over half a day) and pre-wash them before putting them in. When I run it, the dishes come out squeaky clean—it seems to clean them even better than I do. Since it uses hot water, the door gets really hot to the touch right after it opens, so you have to be careful. However, I am a bit worried about the electricity bill because of the hot water, but I think I'll need to use it for a few months to really know. Using the combined rinse aid and detergent is convenient, but it is a bit annoying that the app prompts me to add rinse aid every time I run the cycle. I mainly use the 1-hour cycle, and perhaps because of the pre-washing, the dishes come out perfectly clean!
Comments (Original): [ 완전 잘 작동합니다! ] || ---------------- || 인테리어 필름 작업전에 급하게 구매해서 설칠했는데 만족중입니다. 보통 식세기가 들어가면 장 리폼이 들어가서 인테리어 필름 시공전에 설치하라고 해서 급하게 주문했는데 바로 설치 가능했습니다. 역시 로켓설치에요~ㅎ LG 기사님께서 연락와서 리폼여부 물어보시고 안되어 있다고 하면 리폼해주는 기사님까지 연결해주십니다. 리폼비는 제 기준 10~20정도 사이였습니다. 설치하러 온 기사님이 리폼도 해주시는 분이라서 저는 한분 오셨고 설치는 리폼까지해서 넉넉하게 2시간? 정도 걸렸던것 같습니다.테이블쏘를 들고와서 복도에서 잘라서 새로 설치해주시고 깨끗하게 정리해주시고 가십니다. 자르고 할때 아무래도 소음이 있어서 이부분은 알고 있어야할것 같아요ㅎ 설치 후 간단한 사용방법 안내해주시고 어플연동도 해주시고 가십니다. 첫 식세기인데 대만족이네용ㅎ 일단 디자인이 베이지라서 제가 선택한 인테리어필름(발렌무디)과 찰떡으로 잘 어울리구요. 음식물 처리기에 찌꺼기 돌아댕기는게 싫어서 최대한 애벌로 불려뒀다가 (반나절이상) 애벌 설거지하고 넣는데 돌려보면 뽀득 뽀득 설거지 완전 잘됩니다. 제가 한거보다 더 잘하는것 같아요. 뜨끈한 물로 하다보니 세척 후 문열렸을 때 바로 만지면 진짜 뜨겁습니다. 조심해야 해요. 단, 뜨거운 물로 하다보니 전기세가 좀 걱정되긴 하는데 이건 몇달 써봐야지 알것 같네용 식세기 세제는 린스 & 세제 통합형으로 넣으니까 간편하기는 한데 매번 돌릴때마다 어플에서 린스넣으라고 뜨는게 좀 거슬리긴 합니다.ㅎ 주로 1시간 코스로 사용하는데 애벌을 해서 그런지 충분히 완벽하게 설거지 됩니다!

Comments (English): [ Piece of garbage worth only $100 ] || ---------------- || My father recently commented that I have been treating this dishwasher like a baby since its recent installation, which infuriated me because this supposedly "premium" dishwasher with a $900 price tag has given me nothing but a total nightmare.First of all, its drying feature is a complete joke. The three drying feature, "Sanitize", "Extra Dry" and "Intensive Drying", even when used in combination, does nothing to make a difference, and your plates, rack and the appliance interior would still come out of the wash cycle like you would come out of a shower without a towel. For some reasons, the Bosch designers think that having a heating rod placed in the unit or "moisture vent fan" are such bad ideas because "it consumes more energy", so a "greener" idea is to just let the moisture build up inside. Sure, you can expect a lot of "green" mold growing "naturally" in your dishwasher. The solution? According to Bosch's customer rep, you have to "manually use a towel to wipe dry the interior after each washing cycle". Another "lower-maintenance" solution is to upgrade for a "higher-end" and pricier models like the 500/800 or Benchmark series that do feature the heating rod and vent fans. But putting this blatant hypocrisy aside, rest assured that even if you treat this model like a baby and spend 20 minutes everyday babysitting it, the mold and odor will not go away - they will just hide somewhere else out of your sight, because this model also does not have any feature to allow you to just perform the draining action, and the condensed water on the interior wall will, after the cycle ends, eventually flow and collect into the drain and accumulate there, enabling mold and odor to germinate there. Therefore, it's impossible for them to be pumped out after the cycle ends, contrary to Bosch's claim. In the User's Manual, Bosch incredibly and unabashedly states the following in the Troubleshooting section: “Appliance interior still wet after wash cycle: Not an error. Condensation drying creates water droplets in the tub. This is normal. Moisture in the air condenses on the inside walls of the appliance, runs off, and is pumped out. No action required.” My only disagreement would be that there is one action needed here indeed: a class-action lawsuit against this fraudulent company masquerading low-end dishwashers without basic functionality to perform proper drying and drainage, most of which are widely available on even low end models made by other brands, and causing biological and environmental hazards to the health of millions of American households. Unless they are taught a proper lesson, nothing will stop their greed from continuing to commit such atrocities.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher was recommended to me because I had a Samsung that died.
Comments (English): [ Not really worth the extra dough ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher was recommended to me because I had a Samsung that died. I definitely appreciate the Bosch Legacy, but as expensive as this dishwasher was, it honestly should be doing a much better job than it is. The third rack at the top is nice except that it interferes with any tall glasses that you would want to put on the second show. Obviously you can remove the third rack, but then there would be nowhere to put spatulas and other larger utensils. The bottom rack at first glance seems to have a lot of room but as soon as you start putting plates and bowls in it there becomes a lot of unused space that would not safely hold anything. I'm also very disappointed with the utensils rack as you only have the option to separate the utensils or remove the grid all together. You can't have some space where the utensils are separated and then an open space for bigger serving spoons and tongs. You either get separated utensils or you get everything bunched together. I was very surprised on the normal setting that some of my glassware did not get completely clean. So I have had to run it on heavy cycle always in order to get everything clean and sanitized. Sentence (English): I bought this skeptical cause of the reviews.
Comments (English): [ Read Full Review- I've waited apx 4 weeks to write ] || ---------------- || I bought this skeptical cause of the reviews. And my experience was the complete opposite. My installer guy was apparently top of the business but arrogant. I ordered on a Monday for install on a Friday. The guy while doing a phenomenal job installing was in his ear pods helping his coworker troubleshoot another problem while complaining how the boss begged him with OT to come out and install (I presume to meet Costcos 48hr window delivery service they offer w/tight turn around time frames) and basically complained the whole time. But he did do a great job at the install no leaks first try, explained everything about how the cords all come pre-sealed from the factory in that white tube. So there is only 1 connector to connect the 3/8” water connector tube. Now for the actual product. I got this one not the bench mark series because I live in CA and my water is hard but not that hard were I need a built in water softer & a interior light (the benchmark series also has “plus” features on 2 other things.) otherwise the top of the line one is essentially like this 800 series with all the same high end tech in it. I came from kitchen aid- and while I am getting used to the diagrams in the manual on how to best place the items I do see this dishwasher fitting a lot more of the random weird item loads easier. Otherwise I usually just put the utensils up top on the third row so I can maximize the two drawers. I have a family of 5 so we make lots of dishes each day. So far I bought the jet-rinse dry aid and will buy that cause it asks for that but will pass on the softener salts- (after 1 month of straight day use x2 a day my items are crystal clear and no spots anywhere on the inside or dishes. I got lucky and used a 0 intrest 9month promo offered by my credit card to help spread the cost out. 155.55 a month is not a bad deal for getting the top of the line Bosh 2025 product that feels built to last. Mostly- the ONLY negitive thing I can really say- is that the drawers do feel cheaper made- than even my kitchen aid old one- so with that in mind- I do make sure I grab directly from the center to not add any twist/torsion to the pull out mechanisms for all three levels. I have adjusted the height to fit small plates on the top rack once and. Have left it more or so in that one spot. And lastly, I work in IT and pairing the dishwasher was not easy- I had to hunt online for the steps. They are not intuitive. -otherwise after I got it set up- I programmed it to auto sense and heat sanitize - and I have only done 1 cycle as heavy mode- for casserole baking situation pans. The idea is cool to be able to select different zones but I feel like wash one zone wash them all the same intensity ect. Otherwise I just finshed a full month and love it, minus the annoying install with the best person from the mom/pop business contracted out.

Sentence (English): I just replaced a 23-year-old Bosch SHV-6803 custom panel dishwasher that finally died, and I must say that I don't think that this new model was an upgrade (though it certainly cost a lot more).
Comments (English): [ Not as good as model from 23 years ago ] || ---------------- || I just replaced a 23-year-old Bosch SHV-6803 custom panel dishwasher that finally died, and I must say that I don't think that this new model was an upgrade (though it certainly cost a lot more). First, the old model allowed you to easily adjust the door tension (e.g., if the custom panel is slightly too light). With the new model a spring replacement is required to approximate the same result. Currently, while the door stays open if opened more than 45 degrees, it is a bit difficult to open, and it springs shut with enough force to be almost dangerous. I would certainly be nervous if I had small children who could get fingers caught in the door as it closes! Next, the old model displayed a zero on the control panel at the end of the cycle so that anyone who opened the dishwasher would know if the machine was just run, and the dishes were clean. The new model lacks such a basic feature and requires that everyone install an app on their phone to receive notifications. The whole Wi-Fi connectivity is a gimmick in my opinion, and they should have just put a little more effort into a better control panel design. While the new machine seems to clean on par with the old machine, the cycle run times are almost twice as long. Drying performance, even with Crystal Dry enabled (which adds another 1/2 hour to the run time), doesn't seem to live up to the hype either. I still find that many plastic items and some glasses (especially ones with idented areas) are wet at the end. As far as loading goes, I like the third (silverware) rack in the new machine, but I liked the wine glass holder design of the middle rack of the previous machine better. The wine glass holders ran the full length of the rack and could be used as another level when loading smaller items. Finally, the template that was included for attaching the panel during installation was not accurate. Despite being as careful as humanly possible, I found that the holes in the template did not align with the actual screw holes when mounting the panel on the diswasher door. All-in-all, I expected better from such a premium-priced machine and am missing my old unit.

Sentence (English): Stay away from this machine.
Comments (English): Stay away from this machine. We purchased this machine in December 2023, in the 1.5 years of ownership we have had to have a technician out three times and have needed to call. the service centre 6x times. - The door locking mechanism failed within the first month of ownership, meaning you couldn't close the door to run a cycle, a tech came out and repaired it - The door locking mechanism failed again, a soft reset restored it.- The powerboard for the machine stopped working, called the service centre and had to complete a power cycle - this continues to happen and it's apparently "expected" that you need to disconnect the machine from the mains every now and again to get it working again. I owned a Miele machine for 10 years before asko and never once needed to do a hard power cycle. I continue to need to do this every few months.- Tech came out again because the door locking mechanism failed. They repaired it.- Locking mechanism failed again - I called up asko asking for a refund on the machine as it's clearly a faulty unit - they refused.- Again today the locking mechanism has failed, called asko - completed a soft reset and it started working again.Having to do some kind of reset on a $2,500 machine every few months is ridiculous. The machine only has a warranty for 24 months - I know that I won't get much life out of this machine post warranty.

Sentence (English): Bought this at the end of July 2024.
Comments (English): [ Damaged Goods ] || ---------------- || Bought this at the end of July 2024. It works fairly well, not nearly as good as our (very) old Maytag from 1998, but it does mostly clean and it's very quiet. However, a month ago, while wiping down the front panel, the white paint came off of a long scratch on the front - revealing the silver front underneath. Now, it's unknown whether the scratch was covered by LG before they shipped to Best Buy, or by Best Buy before they sold it to us, but it was clearly a cover-up so it could be sold at full price. And honestly, I would not have cared, if it had stayed covered up. I tried to buy touch up paint from LG, but they don't sell it anymore. Best Buy was no help - referred me back to LG. LG could honestly not care less. I got tired of writing emails and bought some white appliance paint - that does not match, but at least the streak is now white instead of silver. Extremely disappointed in both LG and Best Buy, as they sold me a defective product. I want a tiny bottle of touch up paint folks - that's all - and I'm willing to pay for it. It exists somewhere, because it was used to cover up the scratch. Alternately, a new front door cover would be accepted. I will likely fulfill my appliance needs elsewhere in the future, and most definitely not with any LG products.

Sentence (English): I'm delighted with the Bosch Series 4 SMS4EMI06E dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Efficient, quiet and modern ] || ---------------- || I'm delighted with the Bosch Series 4 SMS4EMI06E dishwasher. From the first use, you can feel the quality in every detail. It's incredibly quiet (42 dB), perfect for use even at night. The automatic opening at the end of the cycle (EfficientDry) function improves drying without consuming more energy. I love the flexibility of the racks, especially the third one for cutlery, which frees up a lot of space. The programs are very intuitive and varied, and the ability to control it from your phone with the Home Connect app is a plus that has pleasantly surprised me. The wash is impeccable, even with large loads or with stubborn dirt. Plus, the low water and energy consumption is noticeable on the bill. In short: practical, modern, quiet, and efficient. Totally recommended!
Comments (Original): [ Eficiente, silenciosa y moderna ] || ---------------- || Estoy encantado con el lavavajillas Bosch Serie 4 SMS4EMI06E. Desde el primer uso, se nota la calidad en cada detalle. Es increíblemente silencioso (42dB), perfecto para usar incluso de noche. La función de apertura automática al final del ciclo (EfficientDry) mejora el secado sin consumir más energía. Me encanta la flexibilidad de las bandejas, especialmente la tercera para cubiertos, que libera mucho espacio.Los programas son muy intuitivos y variados, y la posibilidad de controlarlo desde el móvil con la app Home Connect es un plus que me ha sorprendido para bien. El lavado es impecable, incluso en cargas grandes o con suciedad difícil. Además, el bajo consumo de agua y energía se nota en la factura.En resumen: práctico, moderno, silencioso y eficiente. ¡Totalmente recomendable!

Sentence (English): There's a lot of function with this model.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher ] || ---------------- || There's a lot of functionality with this model. Prongs can go up or down depending on your space needs. Silverware basket easily removed to fit more pots on the bottom. Third rack is awesome for utensils, and can be adjusted for size if you need to fit a ladle or spatula. Middle rack can move up or down to accommodate larger items. Connects to Alexa / phone app so you can start it remotely. Really, so many cool features. The problem is, you kinda don't need them. I put the prongs down for more of a conventionally spaced rack and never put them back up again. I don't find the new layout on the bottom rack to be better. With the way it's configured, I feel I actually lost space, and I do need to take the silverware basket out all the time. The 3rd rack is necessary due to the bottom's awkwardly placed prongs. Finally, this dishwasher brags about its drying ability but there's still the same pool of water left on the mugs. So, yep, it's such a cool dishwasher with wonderfully engineered features. that you may never use. I got an open box discount on mine, and in that way I feel I paid the correct amount.

Middle rack can move up or down to accommodate larger items. Connects to Alexa / phone app so you can start it remotely. Really, so many cool features. The problem is, you kinda don't need them. I put the prongs down for more of a conventionally spaced rack and never put them back up again. I don't find the new layout on the bottom rack to be better. With the way it's configured, I feel I actually lost space, and I do need to take the silverware basket out all the time. The 3rd rack is necessary due to the bottom's awkwardly placed prongs. Finally, this dishwasher brags about its drying ability but there's still the same pool of water left on the mugs. So, yep, it's such a cool dishwasher with wonderfully engineered features... that you may never use. I got an open box discount on mine, and in that way I feel I paid the correct amount.

Sentence (English): We have had this machine about a month.
Comments (English): [ 800 Series Dishwasher (SHP78CM5N/25) ] || ---------------- || We have had this machine about a month. Much of this review is contrasted with the Bosch Benchmark (2020) that we owned previously. Basic impressions: 1. The construction of the racks inside seems a bit flimsier but they may just be more flexible. At this point I can't really tell. 2. The operation of the machine is distinctly quieter than our previous Bosch and extremely quiet in comparison to the average grade of dishwasher installed by home constructors. 3. You can't access the delayed start from the button panel. You have to use the app. You can set a favorite program in the app and save it to the “favorite” button on the machine. But can't save the delayed start as part of a favorite. 4. The app connected OK and paired OK. It has some weird group of settings involving remote start (i.e. start from the app). You can't set a delayed start in just monitor mode. The remote start is overly complicated. 6. Once you memorize a favorite program, it is hard to tell whether it actually got saved to the machine. Tiny unexplained icons show it has been saved. You have to click a slider that is somewhat hidden to save it to the machine. 7. A saved favorite is overly easy to inadvertently delete. Once deleted you have to start over. Comments: We like the machine and will probably keep it. I have no idea why anyone thought an app or an app with remote start capability was necessary for a device you have to physically stand next to in order to load. Select the cycle options on the door buttons panel; then with your hands wet and maybe greasy from handling dirty dishes you have to get out your phone … get into an app … fiddle around to set a delayed start …. hit the start button on the door, then close the door and put your phone away. The old Benchmark model displayed the cycle status on the floor with a little light projector. You could easily determine the status. The new machine has 1 light. It is on when the machine is running. If the machine is waiting to run, due to a programmed delayed start, you can't tell because the light is off. You can walk up and open the door and the clock will show the delay, then you hit the resume button and close the door. Or I suppose the app might tell you but that is way more steps. As the app is on a smart phone with a touch screen, they have to be fancy and use swipe gestures except they seem to have forgotten that you have to have a way to undo an inadvertent swipe. Nope it just deletes the favorite you were working on. We are worked with the help desk to figure this app out and the help desk did help. If I had my way, I'd get the favorite button on the door set (with delay time) and delete the app. The app wants to sell you stuff and provide recipes and send you lots of notifications. I think I have most of that turned off. It is supposed to be able to provide some condition notices (e.g. need to add rinse aid) but I don't know if that works. I'm a retired engineer; I worked in complex machine controls for 40 years. The button controls on the older Benchmark model were simple straight forward (several clicks plus 1 click for each hour of delay, then close the door). On the new 800 Series machine the combination of buttons and app touch screen clicking requires dozens of steps to get the thing to run with a delayed start, all while standing right in front of the machine you just loaded and then you close the door. The app is not user friendly and is totally unnecessary. I can't imagine a group of engineers that work on controls wanting to do this. It must have been forced by some marketing initiative (which may be why an important setting (delay) is hidden in the app). The app (at least) does NOT require location to be turned on to work and the privacy settings seem robust. If you don't use delayed start, you do not need the app.

It is supposed to be able to provide some condition notices (e.g. need to add rinse aid) but I don’t know if that works.I’m a retired engineer; I worked in complex machine controls for 40 years.  The button controls on the older Benchmark model were simple straight forward (several clicks plus 1 click for each hour of delay, then close the door).  On the new 800 Series machine the combination of buttons and app touch screen clicking requires dozens of steps to get the thing to run with a delayed start, all while standing right in front of the machine you just loaded and then you close the door.  The app is not user friendly and is totally unnecessary.  I can’t imagine a group of engineers that work on controls wanting to do this.  It must have been forced by some marketing initiative (which may be why an important setting (delay) is hidden in the app).  The app (at least) does NOT require location to be turned on to work and the privacy settings seem robust.  If you don’t use delayed start, you do not need the app.

Sentence (English): We have an open concept floor plan and bought this Bosch to replace a previous one which worked perfectly for years and was super quiet--a definite asset!
Comments (English): [ Repeat Customer of Bosch! ] || ---------------- || We have an open concept floor plan and bought this Bosch to replace a previous one which worked perfectly for years and was super quiet--a definite asset! We love how quiet this one is, too, plus it's a good value overall; and does a great job cleaning and drying the dishes It's well-built and pretty well-designed, although just as others said, the configuration of the tines on the drawers makes it a bit tricky to figure out initially the best way to load it. e.g. glasses in the top rack. (Also, it's unclear what function two small flip up/down racks on the right side of the top rack were intended to serve. I have used them for large cooking utensils, but when they're down, the space beneath them is hard to use.) Finally, be aware that several options--which are asterisked--can only be changed via its Wi-fi connectivity. This is definitely a modern feature--and an asset, for most folks. However, it may add a bit of time to getting it set up for regular use. (The good thing is one has the ability to change & then save those features.) The issues with the rack design have caused me to give this appliance 4 *s overall, instead of 5, but I'd still recommend it to others! Hope this helps. (By the way, the installers for Lowe's in the Hampton Roads, VA area--Marsha and assistant Jonathan--were outstanding! They were professional, experienced, friendly, on-time, efficient and cleaned up well before leaving. 5*s to them! ) PS FYI, too: The "Off/On" button is actually labeled on the front panel of the dishwasher as the "Reset" button.

Sentence (English): Wow!
Comments (English): Wow! ~! In fact, I was using a 6-person dishwasher but it was too narrow, so I moved and the space for the 6-person dishwasher was ambiguous, so I ended up buying it while moving. I was debating between 12-person and 14-person capacities, and since this product was the cheapest on Coupang, I thought it would be better if it had a spoon shelf on top, so I paid about 100,000 won more and bought a 14-person product. It definitely seems more convenient because it has a spoon shelf ^^ It has a steam function, a high-temperature dryer, and an automatic door opening, which is perfect. The 6-person dishwasher product had better functions because it had hot air, high-temperature dryer, and UV sterilization, but I didn't use it much after using it, and just opening the door after washing was enough. I had to get after-sales service from a technician once because I put the tray in wrong, and he said that the hot air dryer can damage the machine if you use it too often because it is high temperature! And now that the kids are older, the UV sterilization function is no longer necessary, so I am very satisfied with this product alone. The installer explained to me about adding salt and softening the water, and he said that he uses the same product, and that it is not necessary to use it in Korea because the water does not have a lot of limestone like in other countries. ^^ The space inside is also very wide, and when I used a 6-person dishwasher, I would only wash the dishes and always wash the pots and large containers myself, but now I can just throw them all in, so it's really great. However, there is one drawback! All the button controls are touch. The touch doesn't work well with wet hands. It's really annoying. When I rinse it with an e-liquid and put it in, it's naturally wet, but the touch doesn't work well, so it's frustrating. I have to wipe it with a dishcloth and then touch it. Comments (English): Wow! ~! In fact, I was using a 6-person dishwasher but it was too narrow, so I moved and the space for the 6-person dishwasher was ambiguous, so I ended up buying it while moving. When I rinse it with an e-liquid and put it in, it's naturally wet, but the touch doesn't work well, so it's frustrating. I have to wipe it with a dishcloth and then touch it. Other than that, the color is pretty and I really like it! I made a great purchase! I bought it for a total of 800,000 won with a credit card discount! Sentence (English): I ordered a 14-person Cuckoo Built-in, but I had to give up because I had to completely remodel the lower cabinets.
Comments (English): [ Media Products ] || ---------------- || I ordered a 14-person Cuckoo Built-in, but I had to give up because I had to completely remodel the lower cabinets. While looking for a 6-person countertop, I ended up choosing the \"Media MDWMT0601A-A-KR\" dishwasher because 1) it has good cleaning power and 2) it has an automatic door opening function. Since it has an \"automatic door opening function\", I can leave the dishwasher running without worrying, which is convenient. I ordered a dishwasher-specific detergent, so it's been about 2 weeks since I started using it, 2-3 days after installation, and I'm relatively satisfied. The installer kindly explained everything to me during the installation, and since the counter is made of STone, an additional 100,000 won was added for drilling holes during installation. ;; The dishwasher design is pretty and the functions are good, but to be honest, it's a bit small, and I have to wash the big pots by hand, and my Tetris stacking skills are gradually improving. But I reduced the time I spent standing and working while washing dishes, and since I can run the dishwasher right after eating, I don't have to get stressed out by looking at the dishes piling up in the sink, so the stress about cooking has decreased, and my husband and I are less annoyed. This is an honest review of a product I bought with my own money. Please refer to this when ordering.

Comments (English): [ Recommended for 2-3 person households, but need to consider for 4 or more people! ] || ---------------- || A real review of a 26-year-old couple! A dishwasher, considered a must-have for newlyweds, has finally arrived at our home! Media Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher for 6 people (MDWMT0601W-A-KR, White). Reason for purchase & What I expected My joints are weak, so when I wash dishes with grease, my finger muscles get strained and I have to go to a Korean medicine clinic. So after much thought, I bought a dishwasher. We are a two-person household, and we set our selection criteria thoroughly. Automatic door opening function is a must (prevents water stains and odors) Clean design (harmonizes with the kitchen) Good cleaning power (cleans grease stains) Easy to use (NO complicated operations that require pressing multiple buttons!) Convenient water supply (easy to install) After comparing products from various manufacturers and thinking about it for a few days, I finally chose this product! Unboxing & First Impressions The white color matches well with the kitchen interior. Clean design without any unnecessary elements! The size is smaller than I thought, so it can fit comfortably next to a small sink. The interior is also well organized, and I liked the sturdy stainless steel basket. Connecting the water was easy, and the manual was intuitive, so there was no problem installing it. User review & performance evaluation Cleaning power Grease removal power passed! Even the oily dishes after grilling pork belly are cleaned cleanly. I was satisfied that the cups, bowls, and spoons were all cleaned cleanly and came out without stains. Automatic door opening function When the washing is finished, the door automatically opens to quickly release the moisture inside. It is convenient because you don't have to open the door separately, and the drying power seems to be better! Noise It is quieter than expected! It doesn't bother me even when I run it at night. Water usage It is definitely more effective in saving water than washing dishes by hand. It is said that about 6L is used per wash, which is very economical. Storage space Although it is for 6 people, it is difficult to put in large pots or frying pans. You have to arrange the dishes well to put in as much as possible! It is enough for a 2-3 person household, but it may not be enough for a large family. People with weak joints or sore wrists (It greatly reduces the burden of dishwashing!) These people, consider this! If you have a large family of 4 or more, the capacity may be insufficient. Comments (Original): 미디어 자동문열림 식기세척기 6인용  ＊타공 필수 (1cm) ＊인조대리석 무료설치/천연,엔지니어,세라믹 10만원 설치 ＊일정 조율 가능 (일요일 불가능) ＊아이보리/화이트/민트 색상 ＊건조기능 있음 ＊기본 65분가량 세척  식기세척기는 없으면 없는대로 살 수 있지만 한번 맛보면 끊을 수 없는 3대 이모님중 하나인 가전제품입니다.  시간을 샀다고 할 수 있어요. 식기세척기가 보통 1시간 가량 세척을 도와주는데, 그 시간에 내가 설거지 하면되지?? 하시는 분들이 계시지만 전혀.., 30분 걸릴 설거지, 3분도 안되 정리해두고 식세기이모님이 알아서 하라고 냅두면.. 그시간에 난 다른걸 할 수 있거든요..  설거지거리가 많이 나오지 않아도 식세기를 한다면 훨씬 깨끗하고 위생적이에요. 설거지는 저희가 헹굼을 2번가량 한다면 식세기는 훨씬 더 깨끗하게 행굼하니깐요. 잔류 세제 걱정도 없습니다. ⭕️미디어 식기세척기 6인용은 디자인 정말 깔끔하게 잘만들었어요. 세련된 디자인. 인테리어도 해치지 않아요  어머님 댁에서 음식을 많이 해드시는 편이 아니라 6인용이면 딱 적당한데, 6인용은 보통 집안의 식기류를 많이 안쓰는 집이 좋아요. 가끔 음식 해드시거나 ㅎ ⭕️아니면 아기가 있다면, 아기 젖병 세척기로도 너무 좋구요.  다만 타공이 약간 거슬리시긴 하실 수 있는데 전세라면 꼭 집주인께 먼저 상의 해 보시길 ㅠㅠ !! ⭕️상단/중단/하단 총 3개의 세척날개가 있어 세척 자체가 워낙 깔끔히 되는 듯 합니다. 그릇에 붙어있던 김가루들과 기름들 다 아주 말끔히 깨끗히 세척되었어요.  ⭕️또 전용 수저통이 따로 준비되어 있어 더욱 맘에 들었어요. 저희 기존에 쓰던 14인용 타사 제품은 수저통이 없어 하나씩 나열해야 하는데 젓가락과 수저 일일이 정리할 필요없이 그냥 꽂아만 두는게 정말 좋네요.  ⭕️또 하단 바스켓에 보시면 그릇 세워두는 정리대는 조절할 수 있어요. 좀더 작고 낮은 그릇을 하실때는 좀더 촘촘하게 정리대를 만들면 되고, 아니면 그냥 접어놔도 됩니다. 딸깍! 소리나게! 가성비 좋은 식기세척기입니다. 성능은 훌륭하고 또 대기업과 비교해봐도 손색이 없어요.  식기세척기 세제가 아무리 좋아도 가전 자체가 좋으니 너무 만족스러워요.  ⭕️세제 투입구는 처음에 응??했지만 그냥 놔두면 되는거였네요 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ It's a filial piety item that lets you rest on the sofa while doing the dishes. ] || ---------------- || Media automatic door opening dishwasher 6-person, blue, MDWMT0601BL-A-KR, home visit installation overall satisfaction overall review I installed this media dishwasher at my parents' house. Although it is a large family, my mom and dad usually live together, so they don't wash the dishes all at once but collect them and do it themselves. As a result, they do it roughly and stuck-on food and pepper powder don't come off well. I already use a dishwasher in my newlywed home, so I know the advantages of a dishwasher well, so I really wanted to give it to my parents. I bought a countertop product from another brand before, but the technician said that we couldn't install a separate dishwasher because we use it at the same time as a water purifier, so I returned it. However, the technician did a good job installing the media dishwasher (there was no additional charge), so my parents also started using the dishwasher! Since the dishwasher detergent is a countertop product, it is a 6-person product and doesn't hold a lot of dishes, so I cut it in half and use it. Liquid detergent or powder detergent was also recommended, but I just used the tablet mini product that came with it instead of using a separate rinse. It washed very cleanly without any detergent left. It feels like it was cleaned more cleanly because the water stream doesn't just rotate at the bottom but also goes up and down. Also, there is a dish-add function in the middle of the wash, so you can put everything in without forgetting anything. I like the door-opening function the most when it's done. The product I used before didn't open the door automatically, so sometimes I forgot to open it and a lot of water would accumulate inside. Now that the door opens automatically and it dries better in about 10 minutes due to the remaining heat inside! I'm so happy that my parents can do one of their chores a little more comfortably. Sentence (English): This is a review of my own dishwasher after 3 months of use.
Comments (English): [ Wow, I really recommend it. Why did I only buy it now? ] || ---------------- || This is a review of my own dishwasher after 3 months of use. I moved and finally got to buy the dishwasher that I really wanted to buy when I got married. I searched and searched for information. At first, I was going to buy a 14-person dishwasher, but the 14-person and 12-person ones are exactly the same size. I wondered what the difference was, and it was just that the internal structure was removed to make it a little more convenient to store? Anyway, the size of the appliance itself is the same, but the price can vary so much depending on how you store it inside. Since we are a family of 3 anyway, I thought I could just store it neatly, so I bought a 12-person dishwasher, and it was the best choice. It’s really not difficult to use at all. Depending on your needs, you can wash the dishwasher for an hour or just the top, so if it comes out a little, you can just turn it on. If you just use the standard setting, it takes about 1 hour and 50 minutes, but I think it takes about 30 minutes to dry it with hot steam. There’s no separate steam, but it dries it for about 30 minutes, and all the water evaporates, which is really great. When finished, the dishes are really shiny and warm and I love it! Coming home, getting off work, eating, and doing the dishes, time flies by so quickly that all I did was wash the kid and put him to bed. But now that I just put him in the dishwasher after eating and play with him for a bit before washing him and putting him to bed, my quality of life has really improved. If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a family of three, don't buy the expensive 14-person one. Just buy the 12-person one. It'll be much better value for money! I moved and finally got to buy the dishwasher that I really wanted to buy when I got married. I searched and searched for information. At first, I was going to buy a 14-person dishwasher, but the 14-person and 12-person ones are exactly the same size. I wondered what the difference was, and it was just that the internal structure was removed to make it a little more convenient to store? Anyway, the size of the appliance itself is the same, but the price can vary so much depending on how you store it inside. Since we are a family of 3 anyway, I thought I could just store it neatly, so I bought a 12-person dishwasher, and it was the best choice. It’s really not difficult to use at all. Depending on your needs, you can wash the dishwasher for an hour or just the top, so if it comes out a little, you can just turn it on. If you just use the standard setting, it takes about 1 hour and 50 minutes, but I think it takes about 30 minutes to dry it with hot steam. There’s no separate steam, but it dries it for about 30 minutes, and all the water evaporates, which is really great. When finished, the dishes are really shiny and warm and I love it! Coming home, getting off work, eating, and doing the dishes, time flies by so quickly that all I did was wash the kid and put him to bed. But now that I just put him in the dishwasher after eating and play with him for a bit before washing him and putting him to bed, my quality of life has really improved. If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a family of three, don't buy the expensive 14-person one. Just buy the 12-person one. It'll be much better value for money! Sentence (English): If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a family of three, don't buy the expensive 14-person one.
Comments (English): [ Wow, I really recommend it. Why did I only buy it now? ] || ---------------- || This is a review of my own dishwasher after 3 months of use. I moved and finally got to buy the dishwasher that I really wanted to buy when I got married. I searched and searched for information. At first, I was going to buy a 14-person dishwasher, but the 14-person and 12-person ones are exactly the same size. I wondered what the difference was, and it was just that the internal structure was removed to make it a little more convenient to store? Anyway, the size of the appliance itself is the same, but the price can vary so much depending on how you store it inside. Since we are a family of 3 anyway, I thought I could just store it neatly, so I bought a 12-person dishwasher, and it was the best choice. It’s really not difficult to use at all. Depending on your needs, you can wash the dishwasher for an hour or just the top, so if it comes out a little, you can just turn it on. If you just use the standard setting, it takes about 1 hour and 50 minutes, but I think it takes about 30 minutes to dry it with hot steam. There’s no separate steam, but it dries it for about 30 minutes, and all the water evaporates, which is really great. When finished, the dishes are really shiny and warm and I love it! Coming home, getting off work, eating, and doing the dishes, time flies by so quickly that all I did was wash the kid and put him to bed. But now that I just put him in the dishwasher after eating and play with him for a bit before washing him and putting him to bed, my quality of life has really improved. If you're looking for a cost-effective dishwasher for a family of three, don't buy the expensive 14-person one. Just buy the 12-person one. It'll be much better value for money! Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. When I actually used it, it was a total heaven because it was convenient and clean. It was easy to dry and it was good for storing dishes for a while. I want to use this good product for a long time.

Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before.
