Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Sentence (English): Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes.
Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before.
