Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Sentence (English): I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer.
Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. Sentence (English): So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Comments (English): [ It is a product that is easy to use with a simple and intuitive control panel. ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Product name Midea Dishwasher 12-person MDWEF1233G(W)-KR Product details Capacity - 12-person hot air drying method Power consumption - 1760W (The energy efficiency rating is level 3, but most dishwashers have high ratings. It's not a product that you use continuously, so it'll be fine if you adjust it well.) Flagship design - Large capacity for 12 people Customized washing - 9 washing courses (auto, standard, strong, rinse and dry, high-temperature glass washing, 1 hour, soaking mode, etc.) Practical storage - 3-stage efficient internal design Powerful 3D washing - Top/bottom 2-stage washing Wing size Outside: 598 600 845 Inside: 532 505 633 The size is not small. In the case of my house, the height did not fit, so I gave up on built-in installation and placed it freestanding next to the sink. I like that I can wash and sterilize large kitchen utensils (frying pans, rice cooker inner pots, etc.) because of its size. I really like the design. The installer said that he looked at many products but this one came out really pretty. I prefer angular designs. I call it Zen style. I like a clean and simple style. I don't like materials that are too shiny either. This product has just the right composition. The angular design that fits without any unnecessary elements and the intuitive touch panel are perfect for this part. It is said that a total of 94 pieces of dishes can be washed at once based on the large-capacity 12-person dishwasher. (14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons) I used the inner pot of a 9-person rice cooker, 3 rice bowls, 2 soup bowls, 3 sets of spoons, 4 water cups, 1 frying pan, ladle, kindergarten lunch box, and 3 kitchen utensils, and there was plenty of space. Customized washing according to the level of contamination Provides effective washing for grease and hardened food, etc. In case of high contamination, high-temperature washing Washing time 90 minutes, washing temperature 70 degrees, rinsing temperature 75 degrees, pre-wash With oil In case of low contamination, standard washing Washing time 70 minutes, washing temperature 50 degrees, rinsing temperature 50 degrees, pre-wash Without oil The basics are largely divided like this. The modes are divided according to the degree of contamination, so the level of cleanliness after washing is high. Oil is also removed! We often eat oily foods such as butter or sesame oil at home. Even if we wash the dishes by hand, we have to do it twice, but it is really convenient because the dishwasher high-temperature washing solves it all at once. I first wash the dishes, and then I separately run the frying pan and pot in the strong washing mode, and it is just right! And the glass mode - washing wine glasses or glassware. My husband and I sometimes have alcohol time after work, and I was worried about the wine glasses breaking, so I was careful about washing them. It has this mode! It is great! One-hour mode - quick dishwashing when in a hurry, soaking mode - effective for removing stuck-on and dried food, baby product washing course - high-temperature sterilization, etc. The various and detailed modes are amazing. I can feel the will to provide the best convenience for the user! Hot air drying to remove residual moisture After searching the Internet before using the dishwasher, I found that one of the biggest disadvantages is that moisture remains after washing. So I looked closely at the drying function. This product is equipped with a high-temperature hot air drying function, so it thoroughly evaporates moisture after washing. Also, the automatic door opening function after washing opens the door slightly after the course to discharge the internal air, so it provides perfect drying without stains on the dishes, which I am very satisfied with. Noise I was very concerned about the noise because I mostly use the dishwasher in the evening or at night. My husband doesn't notice any noise when he's asleep, but my son is a sensitive sleeper. I was concerned because there were many reviews about the noise of the dishwasher on the Internet. This product is not completely noiseless when it's in operation, but I think it's within the acceptable range. It's quiet at 50db (I think there's a little difference depending on the mode). Cleaning power The most fundamental thing about a dishwasher is its cleaning power. I used it as an all-in-one product. I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, except for the slight water marks on the glass surface when in glass mode. The palace pan that I used to make Nurungji Samgyetang and the party work that I used to fry steamed chicken and rice in were all cleaned (powerful cleaning mode). The color of the plated Buldak Bokkeum Myeon also came off cleanly. I was a little concerned because the product description for power consumption said 1760W for Grade 3. However, when I looked at the grade chart, it was a little over 50,000 won per year. Of course, there will be differences depending on the usage conditions. It doesn't seem like a big concern if you only use it when you use it, not like an appliance like a refrigerator that runs 365 days a year. App linkage You can link it after downloading the SmartHome app. Advantages: 9 washing courses and finely divided usage modes. High-temperature washing and standard washing can be used separately. Hot air drying and automatic door opening (I turn it on at night and when I look at it in the morning, the door is slightly open and the inside is fluffy, which makes me feel good.) Space utilization with 3-tier shelves (upper and lower washing wings and ceiling nozzle) Adjustable upper shelf position Full wash / soaking (pre-wash) / glass mode Change course during washing Large capacity for 12 people Disadvantages: It's a bit bulky because it's large for 12 people. However, it's solved because it's freestanding in addition to built-in! User review: This is a house where a 6-year-old boy, who is like a lion in the jungle, lives. I've been sterilizing dishes in a bottle sterilizer. However, as the child grew up, the number of dishes he can eat increased and the use of dishes increased, so the situation arose where sterilization in a bottle sterilizer was no longer possible. So I looked into countermeasures and opened my eyes to the world of dishwashers. There are pros and cons, but most people have never used one before. Sentence (English): The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ 너무너무 만족스러워요 ] || ---------------- || 33인 정원 어린이집에 조리사선생님께서 식세기를 사달라고 하셔서 고르고 고르다가 이것으로 골랐어요.  직접 설치해보니 공간 활용도, 성능, 디자인까지 따져보니 결국 LG 디오스 오브제컬렉션 DEE6BG 빌트인 식기세척기로 결정했어요. 결론부터 말하면 ‘왜 진작 안 샀을까’ 싶을 정도로 만족하고 있습니다.  먼저 디자인부터 말씀드리자면, 컬러가 굉장히 고급스럽습니다. 주방 인테리어와 자연스럽게 어우러져서 따로 튀지 않고, 오브제컬렉션 특유의 감성적인 색감이 주방 분위기를 확 살려줘요. 깔끔한 빌트인 방식이라 군더더기 없이 매끈하게 마감된 것도 마음에 들었습니다.  설치 서비스도 만족스러웠습니다. 기사님이 방문 전에 미리 연락 주시고, 설치도 깔끔하게 진행해 주셨어요. 수납장을 설치하고 빌트인을 해야 했는데, 마감이나 동선 처리도 세심하게 해 주셔서 불편함 없이 잘 마무리됐습니다.  성능 면에서는 정말 기대 이상이에요. 그동안 손설거지하면서 고생했는데, 요즘은 식사 후 그릇만 대충 물에 헹궈 넣고 돌리면 끝. 시간은 물론이고 물 사용량도 훨씬 줄어든 게 체감됩니다. 기본 코스 외에도 강력 세척, 자동 세척, 에코 모드 등 상황에 따라 선택할 수 있어서 실용적이고, 특히 트루스팀 기능이 있어서 기름때나 냄새 제거가 탁월합니다. 유리컵도 뿌연 자국 없이 반짝반짝하게 나와요.  내부 구조도 잘 설계되어 있어서 대용량 식기도 잘 들어가고, 식기 바구니의 높낮이를 조절할 수 있어서 후라이팬이나 국솥 같은 부피 큰 조리도구도 쉽게 넣을 수 있어요. 처음에는 이게 과연 잘 닦일까 의심했는데, 사용해보니 그 걱정은 전혀 할 필요 없더라고요. 건조 기능도 만족스럽고, 세척 후 문을 자동으로 살짝 열어주는 기능 덕분에 내부 습기도 잘 빠져서 꿉꿉한 냄새가 안 납니다.  소음도 거의 없어서 일반 가정집에서는 밤에 돌려도 불편하지 않을 것 같아요. 생각보다 훨씬 조용합니다. 에너지 효율도 좋고, 세제도 일반 식기세척기 전용 캡슐로 간편하게 사용할 수 있어서 관리도 쉬운 편이에요.  참고할 점은, 설치 전에 정확한 사이즈 확인은 꼭 하셔야 해요. 빌트인 제품이다 보니 싱크대 구조나 전기/수도 배관 위치에 따라 사전 조율이 필요합니다. 저희도 설치 하루 전에 기사님과 상담하면서 조정했어요.  총평하자면, 단순히 설거지를 대신해주는 기계를 넘어서, 시간 절약과 삶의 질을 높여주는 가전이라고 생각합니다. 주방 인테리어를 중요시하면서도 성능까지 챙기고 싶은 분들께는 강력히 추천드리고 싶어요. 특히 요리 자주 하시는 분들이라면 식기세척기 한 번 들이시면 절대 후회 안 하실 겁니다.

Sentence (English): To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I was also satisfied with the installation service.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.
