After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at the 33-person garden daycare asked me to buy a dishwasher, so I chose this one after much deliberation. After installing it myself, I decided on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher after considering the space utilization, performance, and design. To sum it up, I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me talk about the design. The color is very luxurious. It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. The internal structure is well designed, so large dishes can be stored well, and the height of the dish basket can be adjusted, so you can easily put in large cooking utensils such as frying pans and pots. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. One thing to note is that you must check the exact size before installation. Since it is a built-in product, pre-adjustment is necessary depending on the sink structure and the location of the electric/water pipes. We also adjusted it while consulting with the technician the day before installation. In summary, I think it is not just a machine that does the dishes for you, but an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I would like to strongly recommend it to those who value kitchen interiors while also wanting to take care of performance. Especially if you cook often, you will never regret buying a dishwasher.

It blends naturally with the kitchen interior, so it doesn't stand out, and the Objet Collection's unique emotional color really brings out the kitchen atmosphere. I also liked the neat built-in style, which was finished smoothly without any unnecessary details. I was also satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance before visiting, and the installation was done neatly. I had to install the storage cabinet and do the built-in, but the finishing and route management were meticulously done, so it was finished without any inconvenience. In terms of performance, it really exceeded my expectations. I used to have a hard time washing dishes by hand, but these days, after eating, I just rinse the dishes in water and run it. I can feel that not only the time but also the water usage has been reduced significantly. In addition to the basic course, you can choose from powerful cleaning, automatic cleaning, and eco mode depending on the situation, so it is practical, and in particular, the True Steam function is excellent for removing grease and odors. Glass cups also come out sparkling without any cloudy marks. At first, I was skeptical about whether this would clean well, but after using it, I didn't have to worry at all. The drying function is also satisfactory, and thanks to the function that automatically opens the door slightly after washing, the internal moisture is well removed, so there is no musty smell. It is also almost noiseless, so I think it will be comfortable to run it at night in an ordinary home. It is much quieter than I thought. It is also energy efficient, and the detergent can be used conveniently as a capsule for general dishwashers, so it is easy to manage. Sentence (English): The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. Sentence (English): The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical.
Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I am so so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in dishwasher, but he was meticulous with the finishing and flow, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the dishwasher. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior allows for ample storage for large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish basket makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in the average home. It's much quieter than you might expect. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. Please note: Be sure to check the exact dimensions before installation. As it's a built-in product, you may need to adjust the unit based on your sink configuration and the location of your electrical and plumbing pipes. We also consulted with the technician the day before installation and made adjustments. Overall, I think it's more than just a dishwasher; it's an appliance that saves time and improves your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values kitchen aesthetics while also looking for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret purchasing a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one.
Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. Sentence (English): After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

Sentence (English): It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere.
Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. Comments (English): [ I'm so, so satisfied ] || ---------------- || The chef at my 33-person daycare center asked me to buy a dishwasher, so after much deliberation, I settled on this one. After installing it myself, I considered its space efficiency, performance, and design, ultimately deciding on the LG Dios Objet Collection DEE6BG built-in dishwasher. To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. I had to install the cabinets and then install the built-in unit, and their meticulous attention to detail in the finish and flow arrangements ensured a smooth and hassle-free installation. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. I notice a significant reduction in both time and water usage. In addition to the basic cycle, you can choose from powerful, automatic, and eco modes, making it practical. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. The well-designed interior can easily accommodate large dishes, and the height-adjustable dish rack makes it easy to accommodate large cooking utensils like frying pans and soup pots. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. Because it's a built-in appliance, pre-adjustment may be necessary depending on the sink layout and the location of the electrical and plumbing pipes. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

To sum it up, I'm so satisfied with it that I'm wondering why I didn't buy it sooner. First, let me start with the design: the colors are incredibly luxurious. It blends seamlessly with the kitchen interior, without standing out, and the Objet Collection's signature emotional colors really liven up the kitchen atmosphere. I also appreciated the clean, built-in design, which created a sleek, uncluttered finish. I was also very satisfied with the installation service. The technician contacted me in advance and completed the installation with great care. Performance-wise, it truly exceeded my expectations. I used to struggle with hand-washing, but now, after a meal, I simply rinse the dishes in water and run the washer. The TrueSteam function is particularly effective at removing grease and odors. Even glassware comes out sparkling clean and free of cloudiness. Initially, I was skeptical about the dishwasher's cleaning performance, but after using it, I was convinced those worries were completely unnecessary. The drying function is also satisfactory, and the automatic door-opening feature after each wash helps remove moisture from the interior, eliminating musty odors. It's also virtually silent, making it ideal for nighttime use in most homes. It's much quieter than I expected. It's also energy-efficient, and the detergent is a simple capsule designed for regular dishwashers, making maintenance a breeze. It's important to check the exact dimensions before installation. We consulted with the installer the day before installation to make these adjustments. In summary, I believe this appliance goes beyond simply doing the dishes for you; it saves you time and enhances your quality of life. I highly recommend it to anyone who values their kitchen aesthetic while also striving for performance. Especially if you cook frequently, you won't regret investing in a dishwasher.

No more Maytags for us for sure!

Sentence (English): We had this dishwasher in our previous home and I wish we could have taken it with us when we moved.
Comments (English): We had this dishwasher in our previous home and I wish we could have taken it with us when we moved. That's how great this is. There's enough room on the third rack to wash all the utensils our family uses in a typical day, meaning I could leave the utensils tray out of the bottom rack, making extra room for larger items. It washed remarkably well, and you can balance washing performance, time, and energy and water conservation by picking the right cycle for how soiled the dishes are. The ProWash cycle is always going to clean well but uses the most time and water. Other cycles use less and often clean quite well too. We most often used Normal and found it did great on all but the most baked on stuff. And it's virtual silent when running. You'll hear it fill and drain water, but while it's running you'd need to be within a foot of the dishwasher door to hear it. On top of that it feels and looks high quality. The only mild con in my book is that the top control panel is very sensitive,.and I often accidentally selected something when just brushing a hand or arm over it when getting something out or closing the door. I highly recommend this model. If it's still being sold when my current dishwasher finally dies, I'd buy another.

Silentios, incapator.FYI: Cei care aveti de gand sa instalati led in plintele de la mobila masinile incorporabile incurca mult pentru ca trebuie taiat din partea de sus al plintii unde ar trebui sa continua firul ledului. Usa de la masina la deschidere are nevoie de un pic mai mult spatiu decat plinta intreaga ar permite. Eu m0-am trezit cu situatia asta, nu am fost avertizat si acuma sunt nevoit sa intrerup ledul la misna de spalat.

However, my experience has been far from satisfactory.Upon delivery, the installation team immediately informed me that they could not proceed due to the dishwasher's placement not being directly adjacent to the sink. They said additional parts would be required and the installation would take about three hours - adding an unexpected $200+ cost. Faced with this sudden decision, I had to make a judgment call and decline the installation.Ultimately, we were able to install the dishwasher ourselves and found that the provided parts were sufficient with no additional installation complications. Moreover, the process took under three hours, despite this being my first time installing a dishwasher.To further add to my frustration, my old dishwasher which was to be hauled away, but was never removed. This placed a burden on me as I have a shoulder injury and had to rely on friends for assistance. The inclusion of installation and haul away services was a key factor in the purchasing decision, and the failure to deliver on these commitments has been deeply disappointing. Given the circumstances, I would appreciate a response addressing this issue and a resolution that reflects Costco's commitment to customer satisfaction.

Sentence (English): Purchase Date / Period of Use: 25.04.12 / Approximately 3 weeks of use.
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for single-person households ] || ---------------- || Purchase Date / Period of Use: 25.04.12 / Approximately 3 weeks of use. Reason for Purchase: In a single-person household, if I don't do it, no one else will. That includes all the housework. I have to earn money, clean, do laundry, cook, and do the dishes. It's just too much work. So, when I moved from a studio apartment to an apartment, I hesitated for about 10 days before finally buying it. Unfortunately, the new location is a bit out of the way, so there aren't many restaurants nearby, and if I order delivery, the delivery fee is a bit high. I ended up cooking a lot at home, so I bought this, and I'm very satisfied with the result. Pros: 1. It's time-consuming. Hand-washing the dishes takes 30 minutes, and running the dishwasher (on standard mode) for an hour is correct. But I bought this to use those 30 minutes for resting and doing other things, so I don't really care. On weekdays, after work, I make a quick meal at home, run the dishwasher, take a shower, do my skincare, dry my hair, check my phone, and catch my breath. An hour goes by in a flash. Even if I can't do it on the weekends, I make at least two meals a day. I run the dishwasher twice and then rest. I'm not lazy at all. This is how single-person households and office workers have to find time for themselves! 2. Is it clean? Very clean. The first day I arrived, I didn't have dishwasher detergent, so I cooked red-seasoned dishes and ran it on the strong mode without detergent. The dishes were very clean and hot. I don't use the two-tier tray much either. So I just put the spoons and cutlery in the smallest stainless steel spoon holder from Daiso and run it, and it came out very clean. Currently, I'm using dishwasher detergent that I bought from Coupang when there was a Gold Box deal. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, I bought a tablet detergent for six people and cut it in half with kitchen scissors. It feels like the detergent lasts longer. 3. Water/electricity bill? I don't know about the electricity bill yet because I haven't received it, but I heard that hand washing uses more water. Minix uses about 6 liters? It's better because it automatically does the dishes once you put them in. And since I wash the dishes by hand with hot water, the heating cost is about the same when you consider it. And since it doesn't require any labor, I think the electricity bill is negligible. The downside is that the capacity is larger than you might think, but it's also smaller. What I mean is, of course, rice bowls, soup bowls, small plates, cups, etc. are fine, but when I'm cooking, it's often too full to fit large items like frying pans or pots. Fortunately, I use Magic Handle products, so if I'm good at Tetris, I can fit them, but I often just wash frying pans and pots by hand. Still, it's not like I'm doing 10 small items. I can just roughly wipe them, so it's not terribly inconvenient. All the other dishes are in the dishwasher, so there's no shortage of sink or dish drying rack space, which is quite satisfying. There's a bit of water noise (see video), but it's a dishwasher, so of course it makes water noise. Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for single-person households ] || ---------------- || Purchase Date / Period of Use: 25.04.12 / Approximately 3 weeks of use. Reason for Purchase: In a single-person household, if I don't do it, no one else will. That includes all the housework. I have to earn money, clean, do laundry, cook, and do the dishes. It's just too much work. So, when I moved from a studio apartment to an apartment, I hesitated for about 10 days before finally buying it. Unfortunately, the new location is a bit out of the way, so there aren't many restaurants nearby, and if I order delivery, the delivery fee is a bit high. I ended up cooking a lot at home, so I bought this, and I'm very satisfied with the result. Pros: 1. It's time-consuming. Hand-washing the dishes takes 30 minutes, and running the dishwasher (on standard mode) for an hour is correct. But I bought this to use those 30 minutes for resting and doing other things, so I don't really care. On weekdays, after work, I make a quick meal at home, run the dishwasher, take a shower, do my skincare, dry my hair, check my phone, and catch my breath. An hour goes by in a flash. Even if I can't do it on the weekends, I make at least two meals a day. I run the dishwasher twice and then rest. I'm not lazy at all. This is how single-person households and office workers have to find time for themselves! 2. Is it clean? Very clean. The first day I arrived, I didn't have dishwasher detergent, so I cooked red-seasoned dishes and ran it on the strong mode without detergent. The dishes were very clean and hot. I don't use the two-tier tray much either. So I just put the spoons and cutlery in the smallest stainless steel spoon holder from Daiso and run it, and it came out very clean. Currently, I'm using dishwasher detergent that I bought from Coupang when there was a Gold Box deal. Since it's a three-person dishwasher, I bought a tablet detergent for six people and cut it in half with kitchen scissors. It feels like the detergent lasts longer. 3. Water/electricity bill? I don't know about the electricity bill yet because I haven't received it, but I heard that hand washing uses more water. Minix uses about 6 liters? It's better because it automatically does the dishes once you put them in. And since I wash the dishes by hand with hot water, the heating cost is about the same when you consider it. And since it doesn't require any labor, I think the electricity bill is negligible. The downside is that the capacity is larger than you might think, but it's also smaller. What I mean is, of course, rice bowls, soup bowls, small plates, cups, etc. are fine, but when I'm cooking, it's often too full to fit large items like frying pans or pots. Fortunately, I use Magic Handle products, so if I'm good at Tetris, I can fit them, but I often just wash frying pans and pots by hand. Still, it's not like I'm doing 10 small items. I can just roughly wipe them, so it's not terribly inconvenient. All the other dishes are in the dishwasher, so there's no shortage of sink or dish drying rack space, which is quite satisfying. There's a bit of water noise (see video), but it's a dishwasher, so of course it makes water noise. It uses water, so unless you're super sensitive, you can ignore it because it's doing the work for me. Overall rating: (5/5) I'm personally very, very, very satisfied with this product. Everyone, get a dishwasher. It'll change your quality of life.

Sentence (English): This is not the first product of this type that I have used so far, from the BOSCH brand.
Comments (English): [ A reliable helper in the kitchen! ] || ---------------- || This is not the first product of this type that I have used so far, from the BOSCH brand. Before that, I used a BOSCH dishwasher, with Zeolite-based technology, which had a big disadvantage: the control buttons were on the edge of the door, in the upper part. After 4 years of use, they gave out and the product could not be repaired. Now I have the SMS6TC100E model, which is much superior. It is not surprising, BOSCH has an active policy of improving its products. Thus, the buttons were moved to the outer front, they are ergonomic, easy to understand and use. The dishwasher is silent, economical and benefits from a control application on the phone. At first, this application had some problems with functioning, especially when registering new devices. In the current version, all the facilities offered are fully functional.
Comments (Original): [ Un ajutor de nadejde in bucatarie! ] || ---------------- || Nu este primul produs de acest tip, pe care l-am utilizat pana in prezent, marca BOSCH. Inainte am mai utilizat o masina de spalat vase BOSCH, cu tehologie bazata pe Zeolit, care avea insa un mare dezavantaj: butoanele de control erau pe cantul usii, in partea superioara. Dupa o utilizare de 4 ani, acesea au cedat si produsul nu a putut fi reparat. Acum am modelul  SMS6TC100E, mult superior. Nu este de mirare, BOSCH are o politica activa de imbunatatirea a produselor. Astfel, butoanele au fost mutate in partea frontala exterioara, sunt ergonomice, usor de inteles si utilizat. Masina de spalat vase este silentioasa, economica si beneficiaza de o aplicatie de control de pe telefon. La inceput aceasta aplicatie avea unele probleme de functionare, in special la partea de inregistrare device-uri noi. In versiunea curenta toate facilitatile oferite sunt complet functionale.

Sentence (English): I have GE Profile dishwasher Model PDT715SYVFS with a stainless interior (not all stainless steel) that has rust and pitting on the bottom after six months of use.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Interior Rust ] || ---------------- || I have GE Profile dishwasher Model PDT715SYVFS with a stainless interior (not all stainless steel) that has rust and pitting on the bottom after six months of use. I was told rust is cosmetic and not covered by the warranty. I believe pitting should be covered. GE does not want to replace the whole unit, but I believe for a dishwasher that is only six months old with this problem, replacement is the correct fix. My expectation is that given the dishwasher operating temperatures, humidity and chemicals, it will eventually rust through. GE sent a Bodewell technician out to examine it and he agreed that it should be replaced. He called GE while he wa at my home and after a long conversation, he said they opened new claim number and he said he “thinks” they were going to replace it. After 10 days I called GE support and was transferred to Customer Relations where I was told the dishwasher works and they will not replace it. After an extended conversation, they agreed to send another technician to get a second opinion. I will update this review after I get the second opinion. BTW – they already replaced an upper rack that would not slide out all the way.

Sentence (English): Replaced an old dishwasher and so far this one has done very well.
Comments (English): [ Going well! ] || ---------------- || Replaced an old dishwasher and so far this one has done very well. I like that it has wifi connectivity and lets me know when a cycle has completed so I can open the door for the plastics to dry fully. Everything comes out very clean always, and I like that it has a cutlery drawer at the top so there is more room for dishes at the bottom. I also like that it has a favourites option which is easy to set up from the app. Good range of programs available and the speed option and extra dry features are handy. I feel the drawers don't slide as smoothly as I would like and are a bit on the bulky side with thick / chunky frames etc. The provided kickplate that goes beneath the dishwasher is far too small, so we kept using the one from the previous dishwasher. The door can be propped open slightly when not in use but doesn't stick out, enabling fresh air in and stopping the bad smells from building up.

I used an 8-person dishwasher in my previous house, and it was perfect for 3 people, but since I'm expecting my second child, I gave the old dishwasher to the buyer and bought a new 14-person dishwasher! I used a Samsung one before and liked it, so I chose Samsung this time too. I bought it in advance in preparation for a 4-person one, but since we're still a family of 3 and the baby is young, when there aren't many dishes, it's good because it's done in 30 minutes on the top rapid cycle. The standard mode is 55 minutes. After eating, it's convenient to rinse the dishes briefly with water pressure and put them in a deep basin before running the dishwasher. There's no separate spoon holder, so I'm going to buy a separate spoon holder and use it. There's a space to put spoons on the top, but it's a hassle to spread them out, but when I use an 8-person one, I just put them in, and they get thoroughly washed, which is good. The Samsung Electronics technician was also very kind and thorough. It's been a little over ten days since I bought it, but recently the automatic door didn't open twice, so I was thinking of requesting after-sales service, but it's been working fine again recently, so I haven't done it yet. If the automatic door doesn't open again, I'm going to request after-sales service. It's good that I can trust Samsung for after-sales service. I'll use it well.

Sentence (English): I purchased this Bosch dishwasher and I am extremely happy with the choice I made.
Comments (English): [ Very good ] || ---------------- || I purchased this Bosch dishwasher and I am extremely happy with the choice I made. First of all, the design is modern and elegant, perfect for any type of kitchen. It is very quiet during operation, barely audible, which is a big plus, especially in open-space apartments. It has several washing programs, from quick to intensive, and the dishes always come out flawless, without traces of water or detergent. The drying function is excellent, the dishes can be put directly in the cupboard after washing. Another aspect that I appreciate is the low water and energy consumption — you can really feel the difference on the bills. The interior is well-compartmented and flexible, which allows you to wash both large plates and delicate glasses without any problems. Overall, a reliable, efficient and quiet dishwasher. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality and performance at a fair price!
Comments (Original): [ Foarte bună ] || ---------------- || Am achiziționat această mașină de spălat vase Bosch și sunt extrem de mulțumit de alegerea făcută. În primul rând, designul este modern și elegant, perfect pentru orice tip de bucătărie. Este foarte silențioasă în timpul funcționării, abia dacă se aude, ceea ce e un mare plus, mai ales în apartamentele open-space.Are mai multe programe de spălare, de la cele rapide până la cele intensive, iar vasele ies mereu impecabile, fără urme de apă sau detergent. Funcția de uscare este excelentă, vasele se pot pune direct în dulap după spălare.Un alt aspect pe care îl apreciez este consumul redus de apă și energie — chiar se simte diferența la facturi. Interiorul este bine compartimentat și flexibil, ceea ce permite spălarea atât a farfuriilor mari, cât și a paharelor delicate fără probleme.Per total, o mașină de spălat vase de încredere, eficientă și silențioasă. O recomand cu încredere oricui caută calitate și performanță la un preț corect!
