(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Sentence (English): I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

(In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

(In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. (밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. (밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. (밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. (밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Sentence (English): Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

Mydia Dishwasher 12-person, White, MDWEF1233G(W)-KR, On-site Installation Reason for selecting the product There are three people in my family, and dishwashers are so common these days. I thought it would be less inconvenient and annoying for me and my mother to wash dishes together, so I ordered the product. 1Rocket Installation and 2-year Free Warranty I had previously been on Coupang and was thinking about buying an air conditioner through a personal seller. The selling price was very low, but when I actually ordered, they added various allowances such as travel expenses + material expenses + hazard allowance + regional surcharge, so the installation fee was more expensive than the product price. I had a lot of worries when ordering this product because I had a lot of worries after selecting the desired date and the installation technician called me on the morning of the same day. He even coordinated the time, which was more convenient than I thought. It was also very convenient because they installed the rocket for free without any cost. I think it would be very convenient to use rocket installation for home appliances. Mydiar is said to provide free delivery, installation, and A/S for 2 years. Since it can be easily accessed through the Coupang app, it seems very good to be able to use it with peace of mind. 2 Design and color My house has a white-toned interior, and it goes very well with it. My mother was also satisfied and said that the color was very pretty, so I felt good too. 3 LED button and various courses First of all, the LED touch was intuitively able to see which button was on the panel. The touch part is luxurious. <Touch-specific functions> *Auto (approx. 70 to 150 minutes): Automatically detects dish contamination and operates in an appropriate mode *Standard (79 minutes): Mode for washing dishes that are not heavily soiled *Powerful (approx. 87 minutes): Used for washing heavily soiled or bulky dishes *Rinse and dry (approx. 51 minutes): Mode for rinsing and drying dishes that have been stored for a long time *High-temperature wash (approx. 90 minutes): Mode for sterilizing dishes and glass products at high temperatures of up to 75 degrees *Night: Mode suitable for use in the evening with low noise and efficient energy consumption The touch is intuitive, so it is not difficult to use. However, we recommend that you read the product manual carefully for more accurate operation. (In the case of high-temperature washing, the washing time is 90 minutes, the temperature is 70 degrees, and the rinse is 75 degrees / the standard washing is 79 minutes, the washing temperature is 50 degrees, and the rinse temperature is 58 degrees.) There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. This review is a subjective review written honestly after actually using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. If it was even a little helpful, please click the 'Helpful' button, it would be a great help.

(밥그릇 14개, 국그릇 14개, 소접시 14개, 중접시 7개, 대접시 5개, 커피잔 7개, 잔받침 7개, 물컵 7개, 숟가락 14개, 젓가락 14개, 티스푼 7개, 총 94개가 들어갈 수 있다고 합니다.)  3단 바스켓으로 공간이 분획되어 있어서 공간을 놀리지 않고 꽉꽉 채워 사용할 수 있습니다. 6️⃣자동 문 열림  세척 및 자동 건조가 되면 열기랑 습기가 생길텐데 일일이 열어줘야하나 걱정했습니다.  이 제품은 자동 도어 열림을 선택할 경우 고온 건조 후 알아서 열려 습기, 열을 배출해줍니다. 7️⃣어플 조작  이 제품은 'SmartHome'이라는 어플을 통해서 간단한 조작이 가능합니다.  글래스케어, 불림, 통세척 모드 등이 있어서 내가 원하는대로 눌러 조절할 수 있습니다. ✅️추가 후기 7️⃣가지 장점이 있었는데 좀 더 사용해 본 후 추가 후기를 남겨보도록 하겠습니다. ✅️이 후기는 쿠팡 체험단으로 상품을 제공받아 실제 사용 후 솔직하게 남기는 주관적인 후기입니다. 조금이라도 도움되셨다면 '도움이 돼요.' 버튼 눌러주시면 큰 힘이 됩니다.

There are times when I feel like turning it on in the evening, but it is convenient because there is a night mode, and in the case of oily dishes, it can be washed at a high temperature of 75 degrees, so it was very convenient when washing dishes with a high degree of contamination. 4 upper/lower dual washing nozzles Before using it, I had a preconception that it would be less thorough than washing dishes by hand, so I used it and habitually touched the dishes. But it made a squeaking sound and washed very well. Since water comes out from various angles such as the upper/lower, it seems to wash very cleanly. My quality of life has improved so much. Large capacity for 512 people, efficient storage space At first, I thought that a dishwasher for 4 to 6 people would be enough for a family of 3. But when I asked my acquaintances, they said that the bigger the better for home appliances such as dryers and dishwashers. Because the internal space is so large, it is very spacious regardless of the number of dishes. (It is said that it can hold 14 rice bowls, 14 soup bowls, 14 small plates, 7 medium plates, 5 large plates, 7 coffee cups, 7 coasters, 7 water cups, 14 spoons, 14 chopsticks, 7 teaspoons, a total of 94.) The space is divided into three baskets, so you can use it tightly without leaving any space empty. 6 I was worried that I would have to open it every time because the automatic door opening washing and automatic drying would generate heat and moisture. This product automatically opens after high-temperature drying when you select the automatic door opening to release moisture and heat. 7 App operation This product can be easily operated through an app called 'SmartHome'. There are glass care, soaking, and full-cleaning modes, so you can press and adjust them as you like. Additional reviews There were 7 advantages, so I will leave an additional review after using it a little more. Sentence (English): Because of my tired personality and distrust of dishwashers, I used to insist on doing the dishes by hand, even though it was difficult.
Comments (English): [ I'll just ask you to rinse it. ] || ---------------- || Because of my tired personality and distrust of dishwashers, I used to insist on doing the dishes by hand, even though it was difficult. However, as I got older, it became harder, so I wanted to at least benefit from the rinse and dry function, so I bought a Minix. However, I was curious about the performance, so I put in one tablet of detergent and ran a full cycle without doing the pre-washing. After it was done, 1. There was a faint, fragrant smell coming from the dishes. I wondered if there was any detergent residue, so I contacted customer service, but they said that wasn't the case. I put in half a tablet and ran a full cycle, and there was no smell. 2. Whether I used one or two tablets of detergent, dishes with eggs, cheese, or sesame oil would give off a fishy smell. Because of this, I would throw away the dishwasher, buy another one, and then throw it away again. It seems that a dishwasher that has to be washed in one container for shared use will never solve this problem. 3. After wiping it with paper and cleaning the pre-washing dishwashing detergent, I just put in vinegar and rinsed and dried it in Minix, but as you can see in the picture, the water stains are no joke. 4. If you put the dishes on the mesh-like shelf that comes with the intention of storing the dishes in two tiers incorrectly, the upper water supply wings will not rotate, and if you lay the dishes side by side on the lower tier, the water stream will not rise up, so only the outside of the dishes and spoons on the second tier will be hit by the water coming down from above, and the inside will not be rinsed at all. 5. Nevertheless, the drying process is carried out at a high temperature, so the dishes will be very hot. In the summer, you don't have to worry about germs. 6. Once the drying process is completely finished, moisture builds up inside after a while, and frost forms on the glass. When you open the door, there are clumps of moisture inside. Is this a limitation of a dishwasher that uses a water tank? You must leave the door open after it is finished. Still, the reason I gave this guy a spot on my narrow sink was to reduce the labor required for repeated rinsing. For that alone, I thought the price and value for money were worth it.

Comments (English): Wow! ~! Actually, I was using a 6-person dishwasher, but it was too narrow. When I moved, the space for the 6-person dishwasher was awkward, so I bought it while I was moving. I was debating between a 12-person and a 14-person capacity, and this product was the cheapest on Coupang. I thought it would be better if it had a cutlery shelf on top, so I paid about 100,000 won more and bought the 14-person product. It definitely feels more convenient with a cutlery shelf ^^. It has a steam function, a high-temperature dryer, and an automatic door opening, all perfect. The 6-person dishwasher had better functions because it had hot air, high-temperature dryer, and UV sterilization, but after using it, I didn't use it much, and just opening the door after washing was enough. I had to get the technician to repair it once because I put the tray in wrong, and he said that the hot air dryer can damage the machine if used frequently, so I shouldn't use it too often! And the kids are now older and the UV sterilization function is no longer necessary. I'm very satisfied with this product alone. The installer explained things like adding salt and softening the water, and I use it the same way. He said it's not necessary in Korea because the water doesn't have a lot of limescale like in other countries. ^^. The interior is incredibly spacious, and when I use the 6-person dishwasher, I only wash the dishes and put the pots and large containers in. I used to wash the dishes myself, but now I can just throw them all in, which is great. However, there's one drawback! All the buttons are touch-sensitive. The touch-sensitive controls don't work well with wet hands. It's really annoying. If you rinse the dishes in a cool, damp dishwasher and then put them in, they'll naturally get wet. The touch-sensitive controls are annoying. You have to rinse them thoroughly before you can use the touch-sensitive controls. Other than that, the color is pretty and I really like it! I made a great purchase! I even got a credit card discount, so my total purchase was in the late 800,000 won range! This product is a top-tier product and is eligible for energy rebates, so if you're eligible, you should definitely check out the rebate. I thought it would be better if it had a cutlery shelf on top, so I paid about 100,000 won more and bought the 14-person product. It definitely feels more convenient with a cutlery shelf ^^. It has a steam function, a high-temperature dryer, and an automatic door opening, all perfect. The 6-person dishwasher had better functions because it had hot air, high-temperature dryer, and UV sterilization, but after using it, I didn't use it much, and just opening the door after washing was enough. I had to get the technician to repair it once because I put the tray in wrong, and he said that the hot air dryer can damage the machine if used frequently, so I shouldn't use it too often! And the kids are now older and the UV sterilization function is no longer necessary. I'm very satisfied with this product alone. The installer explained things like adding salt and softening the water, and I use it the same way. He said it's not necessary in Korea because the water doesn't have a lot of limescale like in other countries. ^^. The interior is incredibly spacious, and when I use the 6-person dishwasher, I only wash the dishes and put the pots and large containers in. I used to wash the dishes myself, but now I can just throw them all in, which is great. However, there's one drawback! All the buttons are touch-sensitive. The touch-sensitive controls don't work well with wet hands. It's really annoying. If you rinse the dishes in a cool, damp dishwasher and then put them in, they'll naturally get wet. The touch-sensitive controls are annoying. You have to rinse them thoroughly before you can use the touch-sensitive controls. Other than that, the color is pretty and I really like it! I made a great purchase! I even got a credit card discount, so my total purchase was in the late 800,000 won range! This product is a top-tier product and is eligible for energy rebates, so if you're eligible, you should definitely check out the rebate. Take care~ I'm so happy that dishwashers have been added to the rebate list since 2025 ^^. I'm so happy~~~~~ For a housewife, a dishwasher is truly a blessing.

Comments (English): [ Good, Wish I got the next best version ] || ---------------- || I'm happy with this compact dishwasher, it does a great job cleaning dishes. A few things to point out. 1) I believe it was made in Poland and when it arrived, the inside was still very wet from what I assumed to be a test wash before leaving the factory. It smelled very chemically, and still a few months in the chemical smell remains. 2) Even on sanitize and extra dry modes some plastic dishes remain wet once the cycle is complete. More of an annoyance as you can tilt the dishes to have the puddle of water run off and let it dry for an hour, but would be nice if it completely dried everything. 3) Buttons on the front for turning on and selecting cycles feel a bit flimsy, I hope they last but I am being careful not to press them too hard. Overall I'm happy with the dishwasher but kinda wish I would have spent the extra $200 or so for the upgraded version.

Sentence (English): I bought this several months ago and feel obligated to review.
Comments (English): [ Totally Regretting this Purchase ] || ---------------- || I bought this several months ago and feel obligated to review. While Costco was wonderful and the dishwasher gets the dishes clean, if I could afford to buy a different dishwasher, I would. It seems like whoever designed the racks/placement has either never-ever loaded a dishwasher or if they have it must have only been plates. Nothing but plates fit well in the bottom rack. it is a struggle to put in bowls (large or small, any type of pyrex container or any other type of baking dish -everything just falls over). Nothing of any height fits in the upper rack. I had to remove the very top utensil rack just so I could put in average size tupperware pieces and lids in. It is a constant struggle to load and I spend way more time loading this dishwasher than any other dishwasher (and I am old). Many times I end up handwashing items because they don't fit and they always fit in my previous dishwasher. So just want to warn everyone, if you wash anything else other than plates, don't buy this dishwasher as I fear you will regret your purchase as much as I do.
